title: Authorizing Appointment of Nathaniel C. Murray as Assistant Statistician in Department of Agriculture Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Let Nathaniel C. Murray, a special field agent in the Agriculture Department's Bureau of Statistics, be appointed assistant statistician without meeting civil-service rules.

title: Abolition of Florida Surveyor General's Office Postponed to June 30, 1908
summary: Postponed the abolition of the Florida surveyor general's office to June 30, 1908.

title: Lands in Alaska Reserved for Educational Purposes Pending Survey by General Land Office
summary: Reserved lands in Alaska for educational purposes until the General Land Office could survey them.

title: Setting Aside Cinder Cone National Monument, California
summary: Created Cinder Cone National Monument in California, protecting the Cinder Cone, its lava field, Snag Lake and Lake Bidwell as examples of volcanic activity of great scientific interest.

title: Setting Aside Lassen Peak National Monument, California
summary: Set aside Lassen Peak in California as a national monument, citing its place at the southern end of the Cascade Range's line of extinct volcanoes.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Claude I. Parker as Librarian or Clerk in General Land Office Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Claude I. Parker of Louisiana to be appointed law librarian or to a clerical post in the General Land Office without regard to civil-service rules.

title: Lands in Washington Allotted to Indians Snain-Chucks and Paul Restored to Public Domain
summary: Returned to the public domain lands in Washington that had been allotted to the Indians Snain-Chucks and Paul.

title: Authorizing Employment of James Powers in Bureau of the Census Without Examination
summary: Let James Powers be employed by the Census Bureau on experimental work developing tabulating machinery, without a civil-service examination.

title: Specifying Salaries of Immigration Commission Members Jeremiah W. Jenks, William R. Wheeler, and Charles P. Neill
summary: Set the pay of Immigration Commission members Jeremiah W. Jenks and William R. Wheeler at $7,500 a year, and Charles P. Neill's at $7,500 including his pay as Commissioner of Labor, dating from April 1, 1907.

title: Authorizing Classification of 33 Laborers Performing Partially Unclassified Work in Customs House in Boston, and Prescribing Procedure for Similar Situations
summary: Brought the 33 laborers in the Boston collector's office into the classified civil service, and let department heads do the same wherever laborers split time between classified and unclassified work.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules to Except Torpedo and Mine Planter Positions of War Department from Examination
summary: Changed a civil-service exception so all navigating positions on the Army Quartermaster's torpedo and mine planters, not just firemen, were excepted from examination.

title: Directing the Transfer of the Vessel Zafiro, from the Navy Department to the War Department
summary: Transferred the vessel Zafiro from the Navy Department to the War Department.

title: Communications and Reports Relative to Certain Territories and Possessions to be Transmitted through the Interior Department
summary: Directed that from June 1, 1907, official communications to and from executive officers of Arizona, Hawaii, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Porto Rico, Alaska, Indian Territory, Samoa and Guam go through the Secretary of the Interior.

title: Authorizing Interstate Commerce Commission to Appoint up to Fifteen Special Agents Before July 1, 1907, Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Authorized the Interstate Commerce Commission to appoint up to fifteen special agents or examiners before July 1, 1907, who could join the classified service after six months' probation and a noncompetitive exam.

title: Authorizing Permanent Appointment of John D. Torrey as Draftsman in Coast and Geodetic Survey Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Let John D. Torrey, a temporary topographic draftsman in the Coast and Geodetic Survey with twenty years of Navy Department service, be appointed permanently without regard to civil-service rules.

title: Boundaries of Nome and Fairbanks Land Districts, Alaska, Redefined; Juneau Land District Created
summary: Redrew the boundaries of the Nome and Fairbanks land districts in Alaska and created a new Juneau land district.

title: Rescinding Transfer Prescribed by Executive Order No. 372-B of November 20, 1905, as Amended, of Certain Lands Comprising Fort St. Michael Military Reservation, Alaska
summary: Canceled the planned transfer of Fort St. Michael Military Reservation lands in Alaska to the Interior Department, keeping them reserved for military purposes.

title: Opening Lands in the Huntley Project
summary: Opened Huntley Project farm units on ceded Crow Reservation land in Montana to settlement under the Reclamation Act from July 22, 1907, with applicants chosen by drawing at the Billings land office.

title: Reserving Further Certain Lands of Gila National Forest, New Mexico, to Protect Water Supply of Fort Bayard
summary: Withdrew more tracts inside the Gila National Forest, north of Fort Bayard, New Mexico, for military purposes to protect the fort's water supply.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Maude Ward Rockwood as Clerk in War Department Without Examination
summary: Allowed Maude Ward Rockwood to be appointed to a War Department clerical position without examination.

title: Setting Apart Inyo National Forest, California
summary: Established the Inyo National Forest on partly timbered public lands in California.

title: Setting Apart Dragoon National Forest, Arizona
summary: Created the Dragoon National Forest from partly timbered public lands in Arizona Territory.

title: Setting Apart as Public Lands a Strip of Land on the Mexican Frontier
summary: Reserved all public land within sixty feet of the Mexican border in California, Arizona and New Mexico, keeping it free of obstruction to guard against smuggling; the strip could be used only for public highways.

title: Modifying Diamond Mountain National Forest, California
summary: Redrew California's Diamond Mountain National Forest, adding some partly timbered lands and excluding others.

title: Enlarging Plumas National Forest, California
summary: Enlarged the Plumas National Forest in California with new partly timbered lands plus part of the Diamond Mountain National Forest.

title: Enlarging Santa Rita National Forest, Arizona
summary: Added partly timbered lands in Arizona Territory to the Santa Rita National Forest.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Clifford Rose as Private Secretary to the Public Printer Without Examination
summary: Allowed Clifford Rose to be appointed private secretary to the Public Printer without examination.

title: Authorizing Appointment of William Phillips and Percival S. Heintzleman as Clerks in Department of State Without Examination
summary: Let the State Department appoint William Phillips of Massachusetts and Percival S. Heintzleman of Pennsylvania as clerks without civil-service examination.

title: Providing for Celebration of Marriages in the Canal Zone
summary: Validated past marriages performed in the Canal Zone by ministers or judicial officers, and authorized them to perform marriages there for couples holding a marriage license.

title: Announcing Reciprocal Commercial Arrangement With the German Empire
summary: Announced a commercial agreement with Germany and, from July 1, 1907, lowered duties on listed German products such as argols, brandies, champagne, still wines and paintings.

title: Diminishing Pryor Mountains National Forest, Montana
summary: Cut certain lands out of the Pryor Mountains National Forest in Montana and restored them to the public domain.

title: Amending Consular Regulations of 1896 Regarding Invoices of Merchandise
summary: Amended the 1896 Consular Regulations on merchandise invoices, so shippers would appear in person before a consul or show original bills only in exceptional cases.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Participation in Politics
summary: Rewrote Civil Service Rule I to bar federal employees from using official influence in elections and to bar competitive classified workers from active roles in political management or campaigns, while keeping their right to vote and speak privately.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Limitations on Transfer
summary: Tightened the civil-service transfer rule, requiring six months' service before any transfer and three years in the old department or independent office for transfers among Washington offices.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Terence V. Powderly as Chief of Division of Information in Bureau of Immigration and Naturalization Without Examination
summary: Allowed Terence V. Powderly of Washington, D.C., to be appointed chief of the Division of Information in the Bureau of Immigration and Naturalization without examination.

title: Enlarging Magdalena National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Redrew the Magdalena National Forest in New Mexico Territory, adding partly timbered lands and returning others to the public domain.

title: Removing Lands Claimed by Manila Navigation Company from Mariveles Military Reservation, Bataan, Luzon, Philippine Islands
summary: Removed lands claimed by the Manila Navigation Company from the Mariveles Military Reservation at the entrance to Manila Bay in Bataan, Luzon.

title: Disposal of Lands in the Former Devil's Lake Indian Reservation, North Dakota
summary: Cut the price of unsold land in the former Devil's Lake Indian Reservation in North Dakota from $4.50 to at least $2.50 an acre, since the remaining tracts were small, hilly or stony.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules to Except Certain Clerks of Post Office Department from Examination
summary: Excepted from civil-service examination Post Office clerks in charge of contract stations and of stations paying no more than $500 a year.

title: Authorizing Permanent Appointment of Samuel H. Cunningham as Clerk in Bureau of Animal Industry Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Let Samuel H. Cunningham, a temporary clerk in the Bureau of Animal Industry, be appointed permanently regardless of his standing on the eligible register.

title: Authorizing Transfer of George S. Fox to Clerical Position in United States Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed George S. Fox, a bookkeeper in the Isthmian service, to be transferred to a classified clerical position in the United States.

title: George W. Woodruff Named Acting Interior Secretary
summary: Named George W. Woodruff acting Secretary of the Interior.

title: Establishing a Committee on Grades and Salaries in the Executive Departments
summary: Created a Committee on Grades and Salaries, with one employee from each department and independent office, to prepare consistent salary estimates for Congress.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Mattie R. Tyler as Clerk in Post Office at Norfolk, Virginia, Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Ordered Mattie R. Tyler appointed a clerk at $800 a year in the Norfolk, Virginia, post office, waiving the usual civil-service eligibility rules.

title: Permitting Forest Service and Biological Survey Officers and Employees to Accept State and Territorial Appointments
summary: Allowed Forest Service and Biological Survey employees to take state and territorial posts enforcing forest, stock and game laws, and let state foresters serve as Forest Service collaborators.

title: Prescribing Rules Governing the Granting and Issuing of Passports in the United States
summary: Set out the rules for passports: only the Secretary of State issues them, at a one-dollar fee, on a sworn written application stating the applicant's birth, residence and travel plans.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Participation in Politics
summary: Revised the June 3 amendment to Civil Service Rule I, restating the ban on using official influence in elections and on classified employees taking active part in political campaigns.

title: Authorizing Permanent Appointment of Mary A. Greenstreet as Clerk in War Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Let Mary A. Greenstreet, a temporary War Department clerk, be selected from the clerk register for permanent appointment.

title: Amending Executive Order 469 Regarding Promotions in Consular Service
summary: Amended Executive Order 469 on promotions in the consular service.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules to Except Certain Quarantine Workers of Public Health Service from Examination
summary: Broadened a civil-service exception covering quarantine attendants, acting assistant surgeons and sanitary inspectors hired for quarantine duty during epidemics.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of John S. Drukker as Pressman in Bureau of Engraving and Printing Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed John S. Drukker, a former temporary employee, to be reinstated as a pressman at the Bureau of Engraving and Printing without regard to civil-service rules.

title: Granting Employees of the Quartermaster's Department at Honolulu, Hawaii, All Rights of Classified Personnel
summary: Classified most civil service positions of the Army Quartermaster's Department at Honolulu, letting approved current employees stay and become eligible for transfer after three years.

title: Permitting Agriculture Department Officers and Employees to Accept State and Territorial Appointments
summary: Extended the June 13 order so other Agriculture Department employees could hold state and territorial posts, and state officials could take Department appointments, with the Secretary's approval.

title: Transferring Purchase of Isthmian Canal Commission Supplies to Supervision of Chief of Engineers
summary: Moved purchasing for the Isthmian Canal Commission under the Army's Chief of Engineers from July 1, 1907, with a Purchasing Department in the Commission's Washington offices.

title: Authorizing Transfer of Horace W. Mitchell to Clerk in Marine Corps Office Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Horace W. Mitchell to move from a Marine Corps pay clerkship in the Philippines to a classified clerk position in Berkeley, California, without regard to civil-service rules.

title: Enlarging Trabuco Canyon National Forest, California
summary: Enlarged the Trabuco Canyon National Forest in California with partly timbered lands and changed its name from Trabuco Canon.

title: Enlarging Black Mesa National Forest, Arizona
summary: Added partly timbered lands in Arizona Territory to the Black Mesa National Forest.

title: Malate Barracks Military Reservation, Manila, Enlarged
summary: Enlarged the Malate Barracks Military Reservation in Manila.

title: Authorizing Employment of Aksel Hansen in Bureau of the Census Without Examination
summary: Let Aksel Hansen be employed by the Census Bureau on experimental work developing tabulating machinery, without a civil-service examination.

title: Enlarging Santa Catalina National Forest, Arizona
summary: Expanded the Santa Catalina National Forest in Arizona Territory to include more partly timbered land.

title: Diminishing Alexander Archipelago National Forest, Alaska
summary: Removed certain lands from the Alexander Archipelago National Forest in Alaska and returned them to the public domain, protecting existing valid rights.

title: Setting Apart Chugach National Forest, Alaska
summary: Created the Chugach National Forest in Alaska, covering public land from Cape Puget along the Chugach Mountains to the Copper River and Cape Cleare, with islands, excepting circles around towns such as Valdez and Orca.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Margaret F. Sterne as Clerk in Treasury Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Margaret F. Sterne to be appointed a Treasury Department clerk without meeting civil-service rules.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Alice V. Fought as Clerk in Treasury Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Alice V. Fought to be appointed a Treasury Department clerk without meeting civil-service rules.

title: Prescribing General Regulations Governing the Dominican Customs Receivership
summary: Issued rules for the Dominican customs receivership under the 1907 convention, placing it under the Bureau of Insular Affairs and having the President appoint and pay the General Receiver and staff.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of William S. Harris as Examiner in New York Office of Treasury Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed William S. Harris to be reinstated as an examiner in the New York appraiser of merchandise's office, despite more than a year's separation.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Harry T. Paterson as Junior Civil Engineer in Engineer Department at Large Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Let Harry T. Paterson, a former Reclamation Service employee, be appointed junior civil engineer in the Engineer Department at large without the usual reinstatement and transfer limits.

title: Amending Executive Order of September 21, 1905, to Correct the Boundaries of Reservation at Old Woman, Alaska
summary: Corrected the boundaries of the Signal Corps reservation at Old Woman, Alaska, which had been described in error in a 1905 order.

title: Revoking Executive Order of June 11, 1907, Regarding Transfer of George S. Fox to United States
summary: Revoked the June 11, 1907, order that had allowed George S. Fox to transfer from the Isthmian Canal service to the federal classified service.

title: Extending Time Limit for Completion of Work of the Spanish Treaty Claims Commission to March 2, 1908
summary: Gave the Spanish Treaty Claims Commission until March 2, 1908, to finish its work.

title: Establishing Tern Islands Reservation near Mississippi River Delta in Louisiana as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Birds
summary: Set aside the mud-lump islets at the mouths of the Mississippi River in Louisiana as Tern Islands Reservation, a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Frank Huntington in Department of Agriculture Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Frank Huntington to be appointed to an Agriculture Department position, using his long experience editing technical and scientific articles, without regard to civil-service rules.

title: Excusing Federal Employees from Work on Labor Day
summary: Excused federal per diem employees and day laborers from work on Labor Day, making it a holiday for them for all purposes.

title: Opening of Lower Brule Indian Reservation Lands
summary: Opened ceded Lower Brule Indian Reservation lands in South Dakota to homestead settlement at appraised value, with applicants filing affidavits in the Pierre land district for a drawing.

title: Portion of Lower Brule Indian Reservation, S. Dak., Transferred from Chamberlain Land District to Pierre Land District
summary: Moved part of the Lower Brule Indian Reservation in South Dakota from the Chamberlain land district to the Pierre land district.

title: Authorizing Classification of A. J. Robinson as Train-Master in Quartermaster's Department At Large
summary: Authorized the classification of A. J. Robinson as train-master in the Army Quartermaster's Department at large.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Chemist in Bureau of Standards Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed the Bureau of Standards chemist post left open by Dr. William A. Noyes's resignation to be filled without civil-service examination.

title: Fixing Salary of Isthmian Canal Commissioners W. C. Gorgas and Jackson Smith
summary: Set the salaries of Isthmian Canal Commissioners Lt. Col. W. C. Gorgas and Jackson Smith at $14,000 a year, effective August 12, 1907.

title: Civil Service General Rule II and Rule X amended to permit transfer of a meritorious overseas non-classified employee into a competitive classified position, with CSC approval.
Authorizing Appointment of W. Dawson Johnston as Compiler of Statistics in Bureau of Education Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Let W. Dawson Johnston, a Library of Congress employee, transfer to the Bureau of Education as collector and compiler of statistics and librarian, without regard to civil-service rules.

title: Reorganizing Accounting and Disbursing Offices and Procedures for the Isthmian Canal Commission
summary: Reorganized the Isthmian Canal Commission's accounts, abolishing the General and Local Auditor posts and creating an Examiner of Accounts on the Isthmus and an Assistant Examiner in Washington.

title: Reorganizing Washington Office of Isthmian Canal Commission
summary: Set up the Isthmian Canal Commission's Washington office, listing which officers work there and putting the General Purchasing Officer in charge of the offices.

title: Establishing Shell Keys Reservation as Reserve and Breeding Ground for Birds
summary: Vacated an 1855 lighthouse reservation on a cluster of small islets in the Gulf of Mexico south of Marsh Island, Louisiana, and set them aside as Shell Keys Reservation, a reserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Revokes Executive Order 666, Which Enlarged Malate Barracks Reservation, Manila
summary: Revoked Executive Order 666, which had enlarged the Malate Barracks reservation in Manila.

title: Amending Executive Order of February 24, 1906, Classifying Certain Laborers, to Allow Increases in Pay
summary: Loosened a 1906 order on classified laborers so they could get pay raises, while still requiring a Civil Service Commission exam for promotion or transfer and capping pay at the usual rate for the job.

title: Reserving Additional Lands for Fort Sill Military Reservation, Oklahoma Territory
summary: Added 372.45 acres of public land in Oklahoma Territory to the Fort Sill Military Reservation, withdrawing it from sale for military purposes.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Four Employees as Clerks in War Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed four women, including two widows of War Department clerks, to be appointed to War Department clerical jobs without following the civil-service rules.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Limitations on Transfer
summary: Amended the civil-service rules governing limits on transferring employees between positions.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Felix Neumann as Clerk in Smithsonian Institution Without Examination
summary: Let Felix Neumann be appointed a clerk in the Smithsonian Institution's Bureau of International Exchanges without a civil-service examination.

title: Setting Apart Tongass National Forest, Alaska
summary: Created the Tongass National Forest in the Territory of Alaska, reserving its timbered public lands from settlement, entry or sale while protecting valid existing rights.

title: Diminishing Chugach National Forest, Alaska
summary: Cut a strip of land reaching one mile back from the tide line on both sides of Valdez Arm out of the Chugach National Forest in Alaska.

title: Extending Copyright Benefits to Citizens of Austria
summary: Extended the protection of U.S. copyright law to citizens of Austria.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Limitations on Transfer
summary: Rewrote the civil-service rule on transfers: employees generally needed three years in their current office and six months' service after absolute appointment, with the Commission able to waive some requirements.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Rachel F. Sullivan as Clerk in Boston Post Office Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Rachel F. Sullivan to be reinstated as a clerk in the Boston post office despite the time limit in the reinstatement rule.

title: Classifying R. D. Scarlett and John M. Newton as Clothing Examiners in Quartermaster's Department, Philadelphia, Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Brought R. D. Scarlett and John M. Newton, clothing examiners for the Army quartermaster's department in Philadelphia since 1904, into the classified civil service.

title: Land in Alabama Reserved for War Dept. for Improvement of Black Warrior River
summary: Reserved land in Alabama for the War Department's use in improving the Black Warrior River.

title: Redefining Boundaries of Camp Keithley Military Reservation, Mindanao, Philippine Islands
summary: Redrew the boundaries of Camp Keithley, a military reservation on Lake Lanao in Mindanao first reserved in 1905 as Camp Marahui, covering about 17,076 acres.

title: Diminishing Medicine Bow National Forest, Colorado and Wyoming
summary: Removed certain lands in Wyoming from the Medicine Bow National Forest, restoring lands not otherwise reserved to the public domain.

title: Ordering the United States Civil Service Commission to Assist the Porto Rican Civil Service Commission
summary: Directed the U.S. Civil Service Commission and federal workers in Porto Rico to help the island's new civil service commission, and allowed transfers from Porto Rico's civil service into the federal service.

title: Authorizing Transfer of Charles M. Irelan to Clerk in War Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Charles M. Irelan to move from the Patent Office to a War Department clerical job without waiting out the six-month limit on transfers after reinstatement.

title: Authorizing Transfer of Charles E. Knight to Shipping Commissioner in San Francisco Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Let bank examiner Charles E. Knight be appointed shipping commissioner at the port of San Francisco without a civil-service exam, since no list of eligible candidates existed.

title: Authorizing Appointment of William Stimpel as Disciplinarian at Carlisle, Pennsylvania Indian School After Examination
summary: Allowed William Stimpel to be appointed disciplinarian at the Carlisle Indian School in Pennsylvania after a noncompetitive exam showing his experience.

title: Amending Tariff of Consular Fees to Specify Passport Extension Fee as $1.00
summary: Set the consular fee for issuing or extending a passport at $1.00.

title: Establishing Three Arch Rocks Reservation as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds and Animals
summary: Set aside Three Arch Rocks, a group of small islands off the Oregon coast, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds and animals.

title: Authorizing Continued Employment of John V. Davis as Automatic Scale Mechanician Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Let automatic scale mechanician John V. Davis stay on the job until his current assignment was finished, without meeting civil-service rules.

title: EO of April 4, 1853, Reserving Lands at Rock Harbor, Isle Royale, Lake Superior, Michigan, Partially Revoked
summary: Partly revoked an 1853 order that had reserved land at Rock Harbor on Isle Royale in Lake Superior, Michigan.

title: Reserving Lands in Alaska for Army Signal Corps Telegraph Lines
summary: Reserved tracts of public land in Alaska, including sites at Donnelly's, McCallum's and Paxson's roadhouses plus a right of way, for the Army Signal Corps to run its military telegraph lines.

title: Establishing Flattery Rocks Reservation as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds and Animals
summary: Set aside the small islands off the Washington coast between set latitudes, including Flattery Rocks, Ozette Island and White Rock, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds and animals.

title: Establishing Copalis Rock Reservation as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds and Animals
summary: Created Copalis Rock Reservation from small islands off the Washington coast, including Arch Island, Sea Lion Rock and Copalis Rock, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds and animals.

title: Establishing Quillayute Needles Reservation as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds and Animals
summary: Reserved the small islands off the Washington coast between set latitudes, among them Carroll Islets, James Island and Quillayute Needles, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds and animals.

title: Thanksgiving Day, 1907
summary: Named Thursday, November 28, 1907, as a national day of thanksgiving, noting a year free from famine, pestilence and war.

title: Enlarging Lassen Peak National Forest, California
summary: Added timbered lands in California to the Lassen Peak National Forest.

title: Enlarging Stanislaus National Forest, California
summary: Enlarged the Stanislaus National Forest in California with additional lands partly covered with timber.

title: Setting Apart San Benito National Forest, California
summary: Set apart the San Benito National Forest from timbered public lands in California, reserving them from settlement or entry.

title: Authorizing Permanent Appointment of Charles H. McLellan as Superintendent in Revenue Cutter Service Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Authorized the appointment of retired Revenue-Cutter Service captain Charles H. McLellan, an expert on lifeboats, to keep superintending lifesaving-equipment construction without civil-service rules.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of John P. Scruggs as Deputy Collector in Internal Revenue Service Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed John P. Scruggs, removed as a South Carolina deputy revenue collector on misconduct charges later found largely unfounded, to be reappointed without civil-service rules.

title: Post Cemetery Lands Reserved for Fort Sumner Previously Reserved by EO of May 22, 1871, Released
summary: Released post cemetery lands at Fort Sumner that had been reserved by an 1871 executive order.

title: Addition to the Navajo Reservation in Arizona and New Mexico
summary: Withdrew a large tract in the Territories of Arizona and New Mexico from sale and settlement and added it to the Navajo Reservation, protecting valid existing rights.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Joseph B. Dalton as Skilled Laborer in Bureau of the Census Without Examination
summary: Let Joseph B. Dalton be appointed a skilled laborer in the Bureau of the Census without a civil-service exam.

title: Addition to the Jicarilla Indian Reservation in New Mexico
summary: Set apart additional lands in New Mexico for the Indians of the Jicarilla Indian Reservation, withdrawing them from sale and settlement.

title: Announcing Admission of Oklahoma as a State
summary: Declared Oklahoma admitted as a state after voters ratified the constitution drafted under the 1906 enabling act for Oklahoma and Indian Territories.

title: Establishment of the Gila Cliff-Dwellings National Monument, New Mexico
summary: Created the Gila Cliff-Dwellings National Monument to protect the cliff houses in the Mogollon Mountains of New Mexico Territory, inside the Gila National Forest.

title: Prescribing Same Extra Compensation for Marine Corps Signalmen as Received by Navy Signalmen
summary: Gave Marine Corps signalmen the same extra pay that Navy signalmen received.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Carriage Drivers for President and Department Heads Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed carriage drivers for the President, department heads and the Secretary to the President to be hired without civil-service rules or labor regulations.

title: Amending Regulations to Govern the Employment of Unskilled Laborers Outside Washington, D.C.
summary: Allowed the Civil Service Commission, in any district, to certify the three highest qualified candidates from its register when filling unskilled laborer jobs in federal offices outside Washington, D.C.

title: Authorizing Civil Service Commission to Waive Examination Requirements Under Certain Circumstances
summary: Gave the Civil Service Commission discretion to waive exams for permitted transfers and promotions and substitute other tests of fitness, with reasons recorded in its minutes.

title: Enlarging Prescott National Forest, Arizona
summary: Added timbered lands in the Territory of Arizona to the Prescott National Forest.

title: Adjusting Rules for Extra Pay for Navy Gun Pointers
summary: Adjusted the rules for extra pay given to Navy gun pointers.

title: Announcing reciprocal commercial arrangement with Great Britain
summary: Announced a commercial agreement with Great Britain lowering U.S. duties on British paintings, drawings and statuary to 15 percent, in return for free entry of American commercial travelers' samples.

title: Granting Certain Employees of the Technologic Branch of the Geologic Survey All Rights of Classified Personnel Except Transfer
summary: Gave employees of the Geological Survey's technologic branch the rights of examined civil servants, except that they could not transfer outside that branch.

title: Establishing East Timbalier Island Reservation as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Reserved East Timbalier Island, a small marshy island in the Gulf of Mexico off Louisiana and once part of a military reservation, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Enlarging Monticello National Forest, Utah
summary: Enlarged the Monticello National Forest in Utah with additional timbered lands.

title: Setting Apart Vegas National Forest, Nevada
summary: Established the Vegas National Forest on timbered public lands in Nevada, reserving them from settlement or entry.

title: Enlarging Aquarius National Forest, Utah
summary: Added timbered lands in Utah to the Aquarius National Forest.

title: Authorizing Transfer of William McCambridge to Competitive Position in Interstate Commerce Commission Without Examination
summary: Allowed William McCambridge of Illinois to move from the excepted to the competitive class at the Interstate Commerce Commission without an exam.

title: Charles Earl, Commerce and Labor Dept. Solicitor, Designated to Act as Interior Sec'y During the Absence of the Sec'y, the Assistant Sec'y
summary: Designated Charles Earl, solicitor of the Department of Commerce and Labor, to serve as acting Secretary of the Interior while the Secretary and Assistant Secretary were away.

title: Authorizing Access to Historical Records of Executive Departments by Agents of Historical Research of the Carnegie Institution of Washington
summary: Told federal record keepers to give credentialed agents of the Carnegie Institution of Washington's Department of Historical Research access to departmental archives for historical research when convenient.

title: Authorizing Extended Temporary Employment of Emily G. Stickney as Clerk Examiner in Bureau of Chemistry Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Emily G. Stickney's temporary job as clerk examiner in the Bureau of Chemistry to be extended until an appointment could be made from a January 1908 exam.

title: Providing for Examinations for Appointment in the United States Military and Naval Academies
summary: Directed the Civil Service Commission, at any member of Congress's request, to help test applicants for appointment to the U.S. Military and Naval academies, if no added expense resulted.

title: Setting Apart Arkansas National Forest, Arkansas
summary: Set apart the Arkansas National Forest from timbered public lands in Arkansas, reserving them from settlement or entry.

title: Establishment of the Tonto National Monument, Arizona
summary: Created Tonto National Monument to protect two prehistoric cliff-dwelling ruins in Gila County, Arizona, about two miles south of the Salt River Reservoir, along with one section of land.

title: Enlarging San Gabriel National Forest, California
summary: Added timbered lands in California to the San Gabriel National Forest.

title: Setting Apart Verde National Forest, Arizona
summary: Set apart the Verde National Forest from timbered public lands in the Territory of Arizona.

title: Instructions to Diplomatic Officers of 1897, Paragraph 42, and Consular Regulations of 1896, Paragraph 441, Amended to Define Relative Rank of Diplomatic Officers
summary: Amended the 1897 diplomatic instructions and 1896 consular regulations to define the relative rank of diplomatic officers.

title: Amending Executive Order No. 527 of November 17, 1906, Newly Defining the Powers of the Isthmian Canal Commission and Its Chairman
summary: Reorganized the Isthmian Canal Commission, setting a quorum, assigning its duties under the Secretary of War, and having the Chairman, also Chief Engineer, divide the work into departments such as construction, civil administration, law and sanitation.

title: Civil Service Rules Section A, Subdivision IX, Amended to Allow Appointment of Shipping Commissioners in Certain Ports (Revoked by EO 733)
summary: Amended the civil-service rules to allow appointment of shipping commissioners at certain ports; later revoked by Executive Order 733.

title: Enlarging San Bernardino National Forest, California
summary: Enlarged the San Bernardino National Forest in California with additional timbered lands.

title: Authorizing Continued Retention of Fifteen Temporary Indian Service Employees Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Let 15 irregular employees working under irrigation engineers in the Indian service stay on temporarily without civil-service rules, but barred adding to the force or transferring them.

title: Authorizing Continued Retention of 126 Union Agency Employees Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed 126 irregular employees of the Union Agency to remain temporarily without civil-service exams, while barring new additions to the force or transfers out of the agency.

title: Diminishing Blue Mountains National Forest, Oregon
summary: Removed certain lands in Oregon from the Blue Mountains National Forest and set terms for restoring them to homestead settlement.

title: Enlarging Monterey National Forest, California
summary: Added timbered lands in California to the Monterey National Forest.

title: Setting Aside Muir Woods National Monument, California
summary: Accepted land in Marin County, California, donated by William Kent and Elizabeth Thatcher Kent, and set it aside as Muir Woods National Monument.

title: Amending Canal Zone Penal Code Regarding Certain Misdemeanors
summary: Added misdemeanors to the Canal Zone penal code for vagrancy, begging, loitering around canal camps and buildings, public drunkenness and disorderly conduct, punishable by up to $25 or 30 days in jail.

title: Amending Canal Zone Regulations Regarding Unclaimed Property Held by Common Carriers
summary: Allowed common carriers in the Canal Zone to auction freight, baggage or other property left unclaimed for six months with unpaid charges, after advertising the sale.

title: Amending Canal Zone Laws Regarding Composition of Judicial Circuits
summary: Divided the Canal Zone into three judicial circuits built from the administrative districts of Ancon, Emperador and Gorgona, and Cristobal.

title: Applying Law No. 6 of the Republic of Panama, Regarding Exclusion of Certain Aliens, to the Canal Zone
summary: Extended a 1904 Republic of Panama law excluding certain aliens to the Canal Zone, with fines for companies or individuals who let such travelers escape into the Zone, exempting workers brought in for canal construction.

title: Setting Aside Grand Canyon National Monument, Arizona
summary: Proclaimed the Grand Canyon of the Colorado River, described as the greatest eroded canyon in the United States, a national monument within the Grand Canyon National Forest in Arizona Territory.

title: Enlarging Tonto National Forest, Arizona
summary: Enlarged the Tonto National Forest in Arizona Territory with additional timbered lands and folded in the former Pinal Mountains National Forest.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules to Except Certain Shipping Commissioners of Department of Commerce and Labor from Examination
summary: Excepted from examination shipping commissioners in the Department of Commerce and Labor who earned $2,500 or more in fiscal year 1907.

title: Setting Aside Pinnacles National Monument, California
summary: Created Pinnacles National Monument to protect the Pinnacles Rocks and the caves beneath them, inside the Pinnacles National Forest in California.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Ernest Coldwell as Revenue Agent in Internal Revenue Service Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Ernest Coldwell, whose job as a Tennessee internal-revenue collector ended when two districts merged, to be appointed a revenue agent without civil-service rules.

title: Huron Land District, South Dakota, Abolished; Transferred to Pierre Land District
summary: Abolished the Huron land district in South Dakota and transferred it to the Pierre land district.

title: Certain Lands in Colfax Land District, New Mexico, Transferred to Lincoln Land District
summary: Moved certain lands from the Colfax land district in New Mexico into the Lincoln land district.

title: Reserving Land in Minto, Alaska, for Use by Army Signal Corps in Telegraph Line Operation
summary: Reserved a tract on the Tanana River at Minto, Alaska, as a military reservation for the Army Signal Corps to operate telegraph lines.

title: Authorizing Employment of James S. Wickham in Bureau of the Census Without Examination
summary: Allowed James S. Wickham to work in the Bureau of the Census on experimental tabulating machinery without a civil-service exam.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Indians as Messengers in the Indian Affairs Office Subject to Noncompetitive Examination (Revoked by EO 754)
summary: Allowed Indians to be appointed messengers in the Office of Indian Affairs after a noncompetitive exam; later revoked by Executive Order 754.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Certification Procedures
summary: Rewrote Civil Service Rule VII on how competitive positions are filled, with the Commission certifying enough names from the top of the register for appointing officers to consider three per vacancy.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Temporary Appointments
summary: Rewrote the civil-service rule on temporary appointments, allowing them only when the public interest required, with prior Commission approval, and only until eligibles could be certified.

title: Announcing Reciprocal Commercial Arrangement with France
summary: Announced a new trade agreement with France applying lower U.S. duty rates to champagne and other sparkling wines starting February 1, 1908, in return for French concessions on American products.

title: Specifying Classification and Pay for Navy Mess Attendants, and Prescribing Additional Pay for Cooks and Stewards
summary: Set monthly pay for Navy mess attendants who were U.S. citizens at $30, $25 and $20 by class, and gave certified stewards and cooks $5 a month extra.

title: Addition to the Jicarilla Indian Reservation in New Mexico
summary: Rewrote the boundary of the November 1907 addition to the Jicarilla Indian Reservation in New Mexico to fix a conflict with the Navajo Reservation addition.

title: Addition to the Navajo Reservation in Arizona and New Mexico
summary: Revised the boundary of the November 1907 Navajo Reservation addition in Arizona and New Mexico to resolve its overlap with the Jicarilla Indian Reservation addition.

title: Reserving Certain Described Lands in Alabama for Use of the War Department for Improvement of the Black Warrior, Warrior, and Tombigbee Rivers
summary: Reserved described lands in Alabama for the War Department's work improving the Black Warrior, Warrior and Tombigbee rivers.

title: Enlarging Trinity National Forest, California
summary: Enlarged the Trinity National Forest in California with additional timbered lands.

title: Woodward Land District, Okla., Abolished, and Lands, Business, and Archives Transferred to the Alva Land District
summary: Abolished the Woodward land district in Oklahoma and moved its lands, business and records to the Alva land district.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Isabel E. McKinley in War Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Isabel E. McKinley to be reinstated in the War Department regardless of how long she had been gone.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Mint and Assay Service Positions Excepted from Examination
summary: Revised the civil-service exceptions for the mint and assay service so each mint or assay office could have one private secretary or confidential clerk and one cashier without examination.

title: Extending Time for Completion of Work of the Spanish Treaty Claims Commission to September 2, 1908
summary: Gave the Spanish Treaty Claims Commission more time to finish its work, extending its deadline to September 2, 1908.

title: Providing Regulations Governing the Right to Trial by Jury in the Canal Zone
summary: Guaranteed a jury trial in Canal Zone criminal cases punishable by death or life imprisonment, setting up jury commissions to draw 60 qualified male residents per term and listing who is exempt from service.

title: Setting Aside Jewel Cave National Monument, South Dakota
summary: Created Jewel Cave National Monument inside the Black Hills National Forest, protecting the cave as a formation of scientific interest; the monument takes priority, though forest uses may continue.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of S. Baillio to Norfolk Navy Yard Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed S. Baillio to be reinstated at the Norfolk Navy Yard regardless of how long he had been out of service.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement and Transfer of Douglas B. Thompson to Departmental Service Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Permitted Douglas B. Thompson, who left Isthmus of Panama service because of illness, to be reinstated with the option of transfer to a department that wants to hire him despite his disability.

title: Reserving Certain Described Lands in Washington for Lighthouse Purposes
summary: Reserved specified lands in Washington for lighthouse purposes.

title: Enlarging Modoc National Forest, California
summary: Enlarged the Modoc National Forest in California by adding nearby lands that are partly timbered.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Exceptions from Examination for Employees in Office of Indian Affairs
summary: Amended civil-service Rule III so messengers in the Office of Indian Affairs can be among the Indians given noncompetitive examinations for appointment.

title: Yellowstone Land District, Montana, Abolished; Transferred to Glasgow Land District
summary: Abolished the Yellowstone Land District in Montana and moved its lands to the Glasgow Land District.

title: North Platte Land District, Nebraska, Abolished; Transferred to the Alliance Land District
summary: Abolished the North Platte Land District in Nebraska and shifted its lands to the Alliance Land District.

title: Amending Executive Order No. 746 of February 4, 1908, Consolidating the Woodward and Alva Land Districts, to Re-Locate the Land Office to Woodward, Oklahoma
summary: Amended Executive Order 746, which merged the Woodward and Alva land districts, to place the combined land office at Woodward, Oklahoma.

title: Prescribing Procedure for Submitting Recommendations Affecting Civil Service Rules
summary: Set a strict procedure for recommending changes in how classified positions are filled: each needs a full statement of reasons, department-head approval and a Civil Service Commission report to the President.

title: Amending Executive Order No. 755 of February 15, 1908, Transferring Certain Montana lands from the Yellowstone Land District to the Glasgow Land District, to Transfer Additional Lands
summary: Amended Executive Order 755 to move additional Montana lands from the old Yellowstone Land District into the Glasgow Land District.

title: Reserving Certain Described Lands at Lowell Point, Resurrection Bay, Alaska, for the Navy Department for Use as a Coaling Depot
summary: Reserved land at Lowell Point on Resurrection Bay, Alaska, for the Navy Department as a coaling depot.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Edwyn N. Purvis as Clerk in Classified Service in United States Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Edwyn N. Purvis, formerly of the Isthmian Canal Service, to be appointed a clerk in the classified service in the United States without civil-service rules.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Edward J. Tupper as Deputy Collector and Inspector of Customs in Stamford, Connecticut, Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Permitted Edward J. Tupper's appointment as deputy collector and inspector of customs at Stamford, Connecticut, without following the civil-service rules.

title: Establishing Mosquito Inlet Reservation in Florida as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Set aside the small mangrove and salt-grass islets, shoals and sand bars of Mosquito Inlet and the Halifax and Hillsboro river mouths as the Mosquito Inlet Reservation, a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Authorizing Construction of Fortifications on the Island of Corregidor, Manilla Bay, PI Upon Securing Any Lands Needed
summary: Authorized building fortifications on Corregidor Island in Manila Bay, Philippines, once any needed lands are secured.

title: Transferring Mississippi from the Internal Revenue Collection District of Louisiana to the Internal Revenue Collection District of Alabama
summary: Moved Mississippi from the Louisiana internal revenue collection district to the Alabama district.

title: Diminishing Lincoln National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Shrank the Lincoln National Forest in New Mexico by redrawing its boundaries and returning excluded lands to the public domain. (The Statutes' contents table misprints "Monument" for "Forest.")

title: Reserving Land in Hogan, Alaska, for Use by Army Signal Corps in Telegraph Line Operation
summary: Reserved a square tract of public land at Hogan, Alaska, as a military reservation for the Army Signal Corps to run telegraph lines.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Charles L. Babcock as Immigrant Inspector in Immigration Service Without Examination
summary: Allowed Charles L. Babcock to be appointed an immigrant inspector for confidential duty in the Immigration Service without a civil-service examination.

title: Revoking Executive Order of March 26, 1901 and Prescribing a New Ration for the Army
summary: Revoked the executive order of March 26, 1901, and prescribed a new ration for the Army.

title: Setting Apart Ozark National Forest, Arkansas
summary: Created the Ozark National Forest from partly timbered public lands in Arkansas, reserving them from settlement or entry for the use and benefit of the people.

title: Authorizing Transfer of Philip W. Reinhard, Jr., Customs Clerk, to Competitive Service Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Moved Philip W. Reinhard Jr., confidential clerk to the New York collector of customs, from the excepted to the competitive class in recognition of nine years of faithful service.

title: Certain Lands Near Chena and Fairbanks, Alaska, Reserved for Signal Corps Telegraph Lines; EO 328-B Revoked
summary: Reserved lands near Chena and Fairbanks, Alaska, for Army Signal Corps telegraph lines and revoked Executive Order 328-B.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules to Except Certain Caretakers of Former Military Reservations from Examination
summary: Added caretakers of abandoned military reservations or posts to the positions excepted from examination, when the jobs go to retired noncommissioned officers or enlisted men.

title: Portion of Hawkins Island, Prince William Sound, Alaska, Reserved as Navy Coaling Station
summary: Reserved part of Hawkins Island in Prince William Sound, Alaska, as a Navy coaling station.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Wilhelm Lutz to Position in Immigration Bureau Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Wilhelm Lutz, assistant chief of police of Porto Rico, to be appointed to the U.S. Immigration Bureau for reasons given by Governor Post.

title: Redefining Boundaries of Naval Coaling Depot Reservation at Lowell Point, Resurrection Bay, Alaska
summary: Redrew the Navy coaling-depot reservation at Lowell Point on Resurrection Bay, Alaska, about 3,350 acres including Tonsina Creek waters, and revoked the earlier Executive Order 760.

title: Amending Regulations Governing the Right to Trial by Jury in the Canal Zone
summary: Tweaked the Canal Zone jury-trial order (Executive Order 750) by replacing "collector of revenue" with "tax collector" on the jury commissions.

title: EO of May 9, 1898, Which Reserved Lands in Washington, Revoked
summary: Revoked an executive order of May 9, 1898, that had reserved lands in Washington.

title: Executive Order 707, Reinstating John P. Scruggs, Confirmed
summary: Confirmed Executive Order 707, which reinstated John P. Scruggs.

title: Prescribing Hours of Labor at Navy Yards
summary: Made four hours a full Saturday's work at overseas naval stations during set hot months, from Cavite and Olongapo to Guam, Tutuila, Honolulu, Guantanamo and San Juan, with time-and-a-half for extra hours.

title: Transferring Certain Lands in Sitka, Alaska, from Navy Department to Army Signal Corps for Use as Cable House
summary: Transferred a parcel in Sitka, Alaska, from the Navy Department to the Army Signal Corps as a site for a cable house and station for military cable and telegraph lines.

title: Time limit on reinstatement waived for a classified employee who lost his health in line of duty as an incident to heroic conduct in saving life (Presidential Letter).
summary: Waived the time limit on reinstatement for a classified employee who lost his health in the line of duty while saving life.

title: Establishing Tortugas Keys Reservation in Florida as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Reserved all the Dry Tortugas islands as the Tortugas Keys Reservation, a preserve and breeding ground for native birds; military use may continue except on Bird Key.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Harry A. Strohm as Special Agent in Office of the Third Assistant Postmaster General Without Examination
summary: Allowed Harry A. Strohm, an Indiana third-class postmaster with nine years' experience, to be appointed a special agent in the Third Assistant Postmaster-General's office without examination.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Henry C. Towers as Expert and Chief in Bureau of Forestry Without Examination
summary: Permitted Henry C. Towers, a Bureau of Forestry expert, to be promoted to expert and chief of the section of purchases without examination.

title: Modifying Manzano National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Redrew the Manzano National Forest in New Mexico, folding in the Mount Taylor National Forest, adding timbered lands and returning excluded lands to the public domain.

title: Setting Aside Natural Bridges National Monument, Utah
summary: Created Natural Bridges National Monument in Utah's San Juan County, protecting the Augusta, Caroline and Little bridges on White Canyon with 40 acres around each.

title: Reserving Land in Fairbanks, Alaska, for Use by Army Signal Corps as Wireless Telegraph Station
summary: Reserved a tract on the Chena River at Fairbanks, Alaska, as a military reservation for an Army Signal Corps wireless telegraph station.

title: Authorizing Appointment of William S. Murphy as Chinese Inspector in Immigration Service Without Examination
summary: Allowed William S. Murphy of Mississippi, valued for his legal training, to be appointed a Chinese inspector in the Immigration Service without examination.

title: Modifying Sierra National Forest, California and Nevada
summary: Redrew the Sierra National Forest, adding partly timbered lands in California and Nevada and excluding some California lands.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Alpheus H. Mahone as Fish Culturist in Bureau of Fisheries Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Alpheus H. Mahone to be reinstated as a fish culturist in the Bureau of Fisheries despite the civil-service time limit.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Positions Excepted from Examination for Interstate Commerce Commission Personnel
summary: Excepted up to 20 special agents in the Interstate Commerce Commission's division of prosecutions from examination, with the Civil Service Commission able to revoke the privilege if abused.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of John Krey as Assistant Engineer in Engineer Department of the United States Army Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed John Krey to be reinstated as an assistant engineer in the Army's Engineer Department without regard to the civil-service time limit.

title: Enlarging Jemez National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Enlarged the Jemez National Forest in New Mexico with additional partly timbered lands.

title: San Juan National Forest, Colorado, Diminished
summary: Reduced the San Juan National Forest in Colorado.

title: Amending Canal Zone Laws Regarding Defacement or Removal of Survey Monuments
summary: Rewrote a Canal Zone law to make it a misdemeanor to willfully damage, deface or remove boundary or survey monuments and signals.

title: Govt. Employees at San Fran., Oakland, Berkeley, Alameda Excused on May 6, 1908 for Reception of Battleship Fleet
summary: Gave federal employees in San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley and Alameda May 6, 1908, off for the reception of the battleship fleet.

title: Enlarging Camp Stotsenburg Military Reservation Near Angeles, Pampanga, Luzon, Philippine Islands
summary: Enlarged the Camp Stotsenburg military reservation near Angeles, Pampanga, on Luzon in the Philippines.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Katherine J. Fenton as Draftsman in Departments of the Washington, D.C. Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Katherine J. Fenton to be appointed a copyist draftsman in the Washington departments without civil-service rules.

title: Reserving Fourteen Tracts of Land in Alaska for Stations on Third Section of United States Military Telegraph Lines
summary: Reserved fourteen tracts in Alaska, mostly along the Yukon River, as military reservations for stations on the Third Section of the U.S. Military Telegraph Lines.

title: Certain lands at Rapids, on the Yukon River, Alaska, reserved for military purposes.
Lands in California Eliminated From Lighthouse Reserve of EO of Jan 26, 1867
summary: Removed lands in California from a lighthouse reserve created by an executive order of January 26, 1867.

title: Setting aside Lewis and Clark Cavern National Monument, Montana
summary: Created Lewis and Clark Cavern National Monument, protecting a limestone cavern near Limespur in Jefferson County, Montana, with 160 acres around its entrance.

title: Creating Commission to Examine Laws for Security of Passengers and Crew on United States Vessels
summary: Created a commission, chaired by Capt. Adolph Marx, to review U.S. laws on the safety of passengers and crews aboard American vessels and recommend revisions.

title: Ordering Heads of Executive Departments to Arrange Salaries to Conform to Recommendations of Committee on Grades and Salaries
summary: Directed department heads to align salaries with the Committee on Grades and Salaries' recommendations, paying similar salaries for similar work as far as practicable.

title: Reserving Certain Lands on Island of Biliran, Philippine Islands, for Military Purposes
summary: Reserved public lands on Biliran Island in the Philippines for military purposes.

title: Biliran Island Military Reservation, Leyte Province, P. I., established.
Changing Name of Garden City National Forest to Kansas National Forest, Kansas, and Enlarging
summary: Renamed the Garden City National Forest the Kansas National Forest and enlarged it with lands partly covered by timber or undergrowth.

title: Reserving Land in Chena, Alaska, for Use by Army Signal Corps in Telegraph Line Operation
summary: Reserved a small tract at Chena, Alaska, as a military reservation for Army Signal Corps telegraph operations.

title: Modifying Dixie National Forest, Utah and Arizona
summary: Redrew the Dixie National Forest, adding partly timbered lands in Arizona and excluding some lands in Utah.

title: Authorizing Continued Employment of Richard H. Taylor as Inspector in Department of Commerce and Labor Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Richard H. Taylor of California to stay on as an immigrant inspector handling confidential investigations for as long as the Department of Commerce and Labor needs him.

title: Civil and Spanish War Veterans Excused on May 27, 1908 for Parade Regarding Removal of Body of Vice President George Clinton
summary: Excused Civil War and Spanish War veterans in government service on May 27, 1908, for a parade marking the removal of Vice President George Clinton's body.

title: Authorizing Employment of John M. Jones as Tariff Expert in Interstate Commerce Commission Without Examination
summary: Allowed the Interstate Commerce Commission to employ John M. Jones as a tariff and traffic expert without examination, at the Commission's discretion.

title: Pocatello National Forest, Idaho and Utah, Enlarged by Adding Port Neuf National Forest and Part of Bear River National Forest
summary: Enlarged the Pocatello National Forest in Idaho and Utah by adding the Port Neuf National Forest and part of the Bear River National Forest.

title: Abolishing Bear River National Forest and Establishing Cache National Forest
summary: Renamed part of the Bear River National Forest the Cache National Forest from July 1, 1908, with the rest joining the Pocatello National Forest; no land was added or released.

title: Fort Keough Military Reservation Abolished; Transferred to Department of Interior
summary: Abolished the Fort Keough military reservation and turned it over to the Interior Department.

title: EO 795 Extended to Clerks and Draftsmen at Navy Yards
summary: Extended Executive Order 795's salary-alignment rules to clerks and draftsmen at navy yards.

title: Authorizing Employment of Charles Lutz in Charge of Statistics and Accounts in Interstate Commerce Commission Without Examination
summary: Allowed the Interstate Commerce Commission to employ Charles Lutz in charge of statistics and accounts without examination, at the Commission's discretion.

title: Disposition of Former Pennsylvania Railroad Company Station in Washington Authorized
summary: Authorized disposal of the former Pennsylvania Railroad Company station in Washington.

title: Four-Hour Workday on Saturdays from July to September for Skilled Mechanics at Navy Yards
summary: Set a four-hour Saturday workday from July through September for skilled mechanics at navy yards.

title: Portions of Man Key and Woman Key, Florida, Reserved for Navy Dept.
summary: Reserved portions of Man Key and Woman Key, Florida, for the Navy Department.

title: Instructing Heads of Departments to Furnish Information to National Conservation Commission Upon Request
summary: Directed executive departments and bureaus to gather and furnish data requested by the new National Conservation Commission on the condition and needs of the nation's natural resources.

title: Boundaries of Lemmon Land District, North and South Dakota, Redfined
summary: Redrew the boundaries of the Lemmon Land District in North and South Dakota.

title: EOs 447 and 584 Revoked
summary: Revoked Executive Orders 447 and 584.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of William J. Dow as Private Secretary to Public Printer Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed William J. Dow to be reinstated at the Government Printing Office as private secretary to the Public Printer despite the civil-service time limit.

title: Salary of William R. Wheeler, Member Immigration Commission, Fixed at $7500 Per Annum
summary: Set the salary of Immigration Commission member William R. Wheeler at $7,500 a year.

title: Whitman National Forest, Oregon, Created
summary: Created the Whitman National Forest in Oregon.

title: Malheur National Forest, Oregon, Created
summary: Created the Malheur National Forest in Oregon.

title: Umatilla National Forest, Oregon, Created
summary: Created the Umatilla National Forest in Oregon.

title: Deschutes National Forest, Oregon, Created
summary: Created the Deschutes National Forest in Oregon.

title: Fremont National Forest, Oregon, Modified
summary: Reorganized the Fremont National Forest in Oregon, which had been created by proclamation in 1906.

title: Deschutes National Forest, Oreg., established and boundaries defined.
Fremont National Forest, Oreg., reorganized and boundaries defined.
Setting Apart as Public Lands a Strip of Land on the Canadian Frontier
summary: Reserved all unpatented public lands within 60 feet of the Canadian border, putting the strip under federal control to better enforce customs and immigration laws; only public highways are allowed.

title: Authorizing Temporary Appointments Under Banking Act of 1908 in Treasury Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Waived civil-service temporary-appointment rules so the Treasury Secretary could staff up to carry out the 1908 act amending the national banking laws.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Andrew Christensen as Special Agent in General Land Office Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed former classified employee Andrew Christensen to be appointed a General Land Office special agent despite reinstatement and transfer limits.

title: Modifying Boundaries of the Gila National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Redrew the Gila National Forest in New Mexico, absorbing the Big Burros National Forest and new lands, while the rest of the old Gila became part of the Datil National Forest.

title: Setting Apart the Datil National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Established the Datil National Forest in New Mexico from part of the Gila National Forest plus additional partly timbered lands.

title: Authorizing Appointment of John McCarthy as Laborer in Charge of Warehouse in War Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed retired commissary sergeant John McCarthy to be appointed without examination as laborer in charge of a Subsistence Department warehouse in New York, given his unusual experience.

title: Establishing Columbia National Forest in Washington from Portion of Rainier National Forest
summary: Renamed part of the Rainier National Forest the Columbia National Forest from July 1, 1908, without adding or releasing any land.

title: Rainier National Forest, Wash., Modified
summary: Changed the Rainier National Forest in Washington.

title: Washington National Forest, Wash., Diminished
summary: Reduced the Washington National Forest in Washington.

title: Chelan National Forest, Wash., Created
summary: Established the Chelan National Forest in Washington.

title: Snoqualmie National Forest, Wash., Created
summary: Established the Snoqualmie National Forest in Washington.

title: Wenatchee National Forest, Wash., Created
summary: Established the Wenatchee National Forest in Washington.

title: Fillmore National Forest, Utah, Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Fillmore National Forest in Utah.

title: Nebo National Forest, Utah, Created
summary: Created the Nebo National Forest in Utah.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Frank E. Elder in Government Printing Office Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Frank E. Elder to be reinstated in the Government Printing Office even though he had been gone from the office for more than a year.

title: Officers of Assistant Japanese and Chinese Sec'ys in Embassy at Tokio and Legation at Peking to be filled in Rotation
summary: Directed that the posts of assistant Japanese and Chinese secretaries at the embassy in Tokio and the legation in Peking be filled in rotation.

title: Enlarging the Grand Canyon National Game Preserve, Arizona
summary: Enlarged the Grand Canyon National Game Preserve in the Territory of Arizona, adding lands set aside for the protection of game animals and recognized as a breeding place for them, where hunting and trapping on federal land became unlawful except under regulation.

title: Announcing the Death of Ex-President Grover Cleveland
summary: Announced the death of former President Grover Cleveland at his home in Princeton, New Jersey, and ordered flags on the White House and federal department buildings flown at half-staff for thirty days, with military and naval honors on the day of the funeral.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Basil Miles as Superintendent in Post Office Department Without Examination
summary: Permitted Basil Miles to be appointed superintendent of the division of foreign mails in the Post-Office Department without a civil-service examination.

title: Yachts of Royal Vancouver Yacht Club Authorized to Visit U.S. Without Entry, Clearance, or Charges
summary: Let yachts of the Royal Vancouver Yacht Club visit the United States without entry, clearance, or charges.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Exceptions from Examination for Paymasters in New York Customs District
summary: Amended the civil-service rules so the New York customs district could fill two paymaster posts, instead of one, without examination, along with its stitch counters.

title: Lewis and Clark National Forest, Mont., Diminished
summary: Reduced the Lewis and Clark National Forest in Montana.

title: Blackfeet National Forest, Mont., Created
summary: Created the Blackfeet National Forest in Montana.

title: Flathead National Forest, Mont., Created
summary: Established the Flathead National Forest in Montana.

title: Kootenai National Forest, Mont. and Idaho, Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Kootenai National Forest in Montana and Idaho.

title: Routt National Forest, Colo., Created
summary: Created the Routt National Forest in Colorado.

title: Cabinet National Forest, Mont. and Idaho., Diminished
summary: Shrank the Cabinet National Forest in Montana and Idaho.

title: Hayden National Forest, Colo., Created
summary: Established the Hayden National Forest in Colorado.

title: Challis National Forest, Idaho, Created
summary: Created the Challis National Forest in Idaho.

title: Salmon National Forest, Idaho, Created
summary: Established the Salmon National Forest in Idaho.

title: Clearwater National Forest, Idaho
summary: Renamed parts of the Coeur D'Alene and Bitter Root National Forests in Idaho as the Clearwater National Forest, effective July 1, 1908, without adding or releasing any land.

title: Coeur D'Alene National Forest, Idaho and Mont., Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Coeur D'Alene National Forest in Idaho and Montana.

title: Pend d'Oreille National Forest, Idaho, Created
summary: Created the Pend d'Oreille National Forest in Idaho.

title: Kaniksu National Forest, Idaho, Created
summary: Established the Kaniksu National Forest in Idaho.

title: Angeles National Forest, Calif., Created
summary: Created the Angeles National Forest in California.

title: San Luis National Forest, Calif., Created
summary: Established the San Luis National Forest in California.

title: Carson National Forest, N. Mex., Created
summary: Created the Carson National Forest in New Mexico.

title: Jemez National Forest, N. Mex., Diminished
summary: Reduced the Jemez National Forest in New Mexico.

title: Sundance National Forest, Wyo., Created
summary: Created the Sundance National Forest in Wyoming.

title: Black Hills National Forest, S. Dak., Diminished
summary: Trimmed the Black Hills National Forest in South Dakota.

title: Santa Barbara National Forest, Calif., Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Santa Barbara National Forest in California.

title: Weiser National Forest, Idaho, Diminished
summary: Reduced the Weiser National Forest.

title: Establishing Nezperce National Forest from Portions of Bitterroot and Weiser National Forests
summary: Combined parts of the Bitterroot and Weiser National Forests into a forest to be known as the Nezperce National Forest, effective July 1, 1908, without adding or releasing any land.

title: Idaho National Forest, Idaho, Created
summary: Created the Idaho National Forest in Idaho.

title: Payette National Forest, Idaho, Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Payette National Forest in Idaho.

title: Boise National Forest, Idaho, Created
summary: Established the Boise National Forest in Idaho.

title: Sawtooth National Forest, Idaho, Diminished
summary: Reduced the Sawtooth National Forest in Idaho.

title: Modifying Lemhi National Forest
summary: Defined the land from the Lemhi and Sawtooth National Forests to be known as the Lemhi National Forest, effective July 1, 1908, and folded it into the Salmon National Forest without adding or releasing any land.

title: Siuslaw National Forest, Oreg., Created
summary: Created the Siuslaw National Forest in Oregon.

title: Cheyenne National Forest, Wyo., Created
summary: Established the Cheyenne National Forest in Wyoming.

title: Medicine Bow National Forest, Wyo., Diminished
summary: Reduced the Medicine Bow National Forest in Wyoming.

title: Cascade National Forest, Oreg., Created
summary: Created the Cascade National Forest in Oregon.

title: Oregon National Forest, Oreg., Created
summary: Established the Oregon National Forest in Oregon.

title: Establishing Siuslaw National Forest and Redefining Umpqua National Forest in Oregon from Portions of Cascade, Fremont, and Former Umpqua National Forests
summary: Redrew the Umpqua National Forest in Oregon from parts of the Cascade, Fremont, and Umpqua forests, made the rest of the old Umpqua the Siuslaw National Forest, and returned eliminated lands to the public domain for homestead settlement.

title: Siskiyou National Forest, Oreg. and Calif., Created
summary: Created the Siskiyou National Forest in Oregon and California.

title: Crater National Forest, Oregon and California
summary: Joined the Ashland National Forest with parts of the Cascade, Siskiyou, and Klamath forests to form the Crater National Forest in Oregon and California, effective July 1, 1908.

title: Beartooth National Forest, Mont., Created
summary: Created the Beartooth National Forest in Montana.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Uinta National Forest, Utah
summary: Enlarged the Uinta National Forest in Utah with new, partly timbered lands, after the Ashley National Forest was carved from part of it, protecting existing land claims.

title: Setting Apart the Crook National Forest, Arizona
summary: Set apart the Crook National Forest in the Territory of Arizona from part of the Tonto, most of the Mount Graham forest, and new timbered land, returning eliminated land to the public domain.

title: Sitgreaves National Forest, Arizona
summary: Formed the Sitgreaves National Forest in Arizona from parts of the Black Mesa and Tonto National Forests, effective July 1, 1908, without adding or releasing any land.

title: Tonto National Forest, Arizona
summary: Redefined the Tonto National Forest in Arizona from parts of the Tonto and Black Mesa forests, with the rest going to the Crook, Sitgreaves, and Coconino National Forests.

title: Modifying Holy Cross National Forest, Colorado
summary: Reshaped the Holy Cross National Forest in Colorado from parts of the Holy Cross, Leadville, Gunnison, and Battlement Mesa forests, shifting its remaining land to the Leadville National Forest.

title: Targhee National Forest, Idaho and Wyo., Created
summary: Created the Targhee National Forest in Idaho and Wyoming.

title: Teton National Forest, Wyo., Created
summary: Established the Teton National Forest in Wyoming.

title: Wyoming National Forest, Wyo., Created
summary: Created the Wyoming National Forest in Wyoming.

title: Bonneville National Forest, Created
summary: Created the Bonneville National Forest.

title: Absaroka National Forest, Mont., Created
summary: Established the Absaroka National Forest in Montana.

title: Apache National Forest, Arizona
summary: Named part of the Black Mesa National Forest in Arizona the Apache National Forest, effective July 1, 1908, with the remainder going to the Sitgreaves, Coconino, and Tonto forests.

title: Beaverhead National Forest, Mont., Created
summary: Created the Beaverhead National Forest in Montana.

title: Madison National Forest, Mont., Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Madison National Forest in Montana.

title: Gallatin National Forest, Mont., Modified
summary: Adjusted the boundaries of the Gallatin National Forest in Montana.

title: Deerlodge National Forest, Mont., Created
summary: Established the Deerlodge National Forest in Montana.

title: Helena National Forest, Mont., Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Helena National Forest in Montana.

title: Missoula National Forest, Mont., Enlarged
summary: Enlarged the Missoula National Forest in Montana.

title: Bitterroot National Forest, Mont., Enlarged
summary: Expanded the Bitterroot National Forest in Montana.

title: Uinta National Forest, Utah, Modified
summary: Modified the Uinta National Forest in Utah.

title: Uncompahgre National Forest, Colo., Enlarged
summary: Enlarged the Uncompahgre National Forest in Colorado.

title: San Juan National Forest, Colo., Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the San Juan National Forest in Colorado.

title: Rio Grande National Forest, Colo., Created
summary: Created the Rio Grande National Forest in Colorado.

title: Pike National Forest, Colo., Created
summary: Established the Pike National Forest in Colorado.

title: Montezuma National Forest, Colo., Modified
summary: Adjusted the boundaries of the Montezuma National Forest in Colorado.

title: Leadville National Forest, Colo., Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Leadville National Forest in Colorado.

title: Gunnison National Forest, Colo., Modified
summary: Changed the boundaries of the Gunnison National Forest in Colorado.

title: Cochetopah National Forest, Colo., Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Cochetopah National Forest in Colorado.

title: Arapaho National Forest, Colo., Created
summary: Created the Arapaho National Forest in Colorado.

title: Battlement National Forest, Colo., Created
summary: Established the Battlement National Forest in Colorado.

title: Shoshone National Forest, Wyo., Created
summary: Created the Shoshone National Forest in Wyoming.

title: Modifying Boundaries of Klamath National Forest, California
summary: Consolidated parts of the Klamath, Trinity, and Shasta National Forests in California, plus some partly timbered new land, into one Klamath National Forest, with leftover land going to the Siskiyou, Crater, Trinity, and Shasta forests.

title: Setting Apart the Coconino and Kaibab National Forests, Arizona
summary: Set apart the Coconino and Kaibab National Forests in Arizona, merging the San Francisco Mountains forest, parts of the Black Mesa and Tonto, and Grand Canyon land south and east of the Colorado River into Coconino; the rest became Kaibab.

title: Tahoe National Forest, Calif., Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Tahoe National Forest in California.

title: Mono National Forest, California and Nevada
summary: Formed the Mono National Forest in California and Nevada from parts of the Stanislaus, Sierra, Tahoe, and Inyo forests, effective July 1, 1908, without adding or releasing any land.

title: Inyo National Forest, Calif. and Nev., Modified
