summary: Adjusted the boundaries of the Inyo National Forest in California and Nevada.

title: Trinity National Forest, Calif., Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Trinity National Forest in California.

title: Stanislaus National Forest, Calif., Modified
summary: Changed the boundaries of the Stanislaus National Forest in California.

title: Sierra National Forest, Calif., Diminished
summary: Reduced the Sierra National Forest in California.

title: Shasta National Forest, Calif., Modified
summary: Modified the boundaries of the Shasta National Forest in California.

title: Establishing Sequoia National Forest in California from Portions of Sierra National Forest
summary: Carved the Sequoia National Forest out of the Sierra National Forest in California, effective July 1, 1908, with the remainder staying the Sierra or joining the Stanislaus, Inyo, and Mono forests.

title: Plumas National Forest, Calif., Modified
summary: Adjusted the boundaries of the Plumas National Forest in California.

title: Lassen National Forest, Calif., Created
summary: Created the Lassen National Forest in California.

title: California National Forest, Calif., Created
summary: Established the California National Forest in California.

title: 55 Specified National Forests Consolidated and/or Renamed
summary: Consolidated or renamed 55 specified national forests.

title: Kaibab National Forest, Arizona
summary: Named part of the Grand Canyon National Forest in Arizona the Kaibab National Forest, leaving the Grand Canyon National Game Preserve and Grand Canyon National Monument proclamations unchanged; the rest joined the Coconino.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Joe M. Johnson in Government Printing Office Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Joe M. Johnson to be reinstated in the Government Printing Office regardless of how long he had been away.

title: George Uhler Designated to Act as Supervising Inspector of steam Vessels in 7th District, Cincinnati, Pending Regular Appointment
summary: Designated George Uhler to act as supervising inspector of steam vessels for the 7th District at Cincinnati until a regular appointment was made.

title: Boundaries of Deschutes National Forest, Oreg. Redefined
summary: Redefined the boundaries of the Deschutes National Forest in Oregon.

title: Boundaries of Fremont National Forest, Oreg., Redefined
summary: Redrew the boundaries of the Fremont National Forest in Oregon.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Four People as Experts in Liquor Suppression Among Indians Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Permitted W. S. Lowe, Grosvenor A. Porter, T. E. Brentz, and E. E. Kinnett, of Oklahoma, to be appointed experts in suppressing the liquor traffic among Indians without regard to civil-service rules.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Herman Gluck in Internal Revenue Service Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Herman Gluck, a deputy collector of internal revenue at New York whose service ended March 1, 1907, to be reinstated even though his year of eligibility had expired.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of George Terwilliger in Government Printing Office Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Let George Terwilliger return to the Government Printing Office regardless of how long he had been out of the service.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of William E. Shields in Government Printing Office Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Permitted William E. Shields to be reinstated in the Government Printing Office no matter how long he had been away.

title: EO 503, Authorizing Extra Pay for Marine Corps Messmen, Amended
summary: Amended Executive Order 503, which authorized extra pay for messmen in the Marine Corps.

title: Further Reserving Lands in Gila National Forest, New Mexico, to Protect Water Supply of Fort Bayard
summary: Withdrew additional tracts inside the Gila National Forest, just north of Fort Bayard, for military use to protect the fort's water supply, while keeping the land part of the national forest.

title: Reserving Lands in Tanana, Alaska, Adjoining Fort Gibbon, for Use by Army Signal Corps
summary: Set apart a tract of public land at Tanana, next to the Fort Gibbon military reservation, as a military reservation for the Army Signal Corps.

title: Extending Time for Completion of Work of the Spanish Treaty Claims Commission to March 2, 1909
summary: Gave the Spanish Treaty Claims Commission until March 2, 1909, to finish its work.

title: Amending Regulations Governing Employment of Unskilled Laborers Outside Washington, D.C. Regarding Period of Eligibility
summary: Changed the rules for hiring unskilled laborers in federal offices outside Washington, D.C., so the Civil Service Commission could keep eligible registers in force longer than one year when the service required it.

title: Exchanging Lands with Porto Rico for Public Uses
summary: Carried out a land swap with Porto Rico: unneeded parts of an 80-acre naval tract on the Caguas road in San Juan went to the island government, which in turn ceded three tracts to the United States.

title: Establishing Key West Reservation in Florida as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Created the Key West Reservation, setting aside the keys and islands of the Florida Keys west of Key West as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds, without disturbing existing life-saving and naval reservations there.

title: Establishing Klamath Lake Reservation in Oregon and California as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Established the Klamath Lake Reservation, reserving the islands of Lower Klamath Lake and nearby marsh lands unfit for farming as a breeding ground for native birds, and banned killing birds or taking their eggs and nests.

title: George W. Woodruff, Assistant Attorney General, Designated to Act as Interior Secretary During Absences
summary: Designated Assistant Attorney General George W. Woodruff to act as Secretary of the Interior when the Secretary is absent.

title: Excusing Federal Employees From Work on Labor Day
summary: Gave per diem employees and day laborers across the federal service the first Monday in September, Labor Day, off as a full holiday.

title: Reciprocity with the Netherlands
summary: Put a commercial agreement with the Netherlands into effect, cutting U.S. duties on Dutch brandies and other distilled spirits to the reduced reciprocity rate.

title: Extending Military Reservation on Batan and Cacraray Islands, Philippine Islands
summary: Extended the military reservations on Batan Island and Cacraray Island in the Philippines to take in the submerged lands, reefs and rocks out to 1,000 yards beyond low water.

title: Amending Penal Code of Canal Zone Regarding Punishment for Grand Larceny
summary: Amended the Canal Zone Penal Code so grand larceny carries up to ten years in the penitentiary.

title: Establishing Lake Malheur Reservation in Oregon as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Created the Lake Malheur Reservation, protecting the shorelines, islands and connecting waters of Lakes Malheur and Harney as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Advancing Money to Capt. Albert Mertz to Transfer Lighthouse Establishment Vessels to Pacific Coast
summary: Authorized an advance of funds to Capt. Albert Mertz to move Lighthouse Establishment vessels to the Pacific coast.

title: Rosebud Indian Reservation
summary: Opened unallotted Rosebud Indian Reservation lands south of the Big White River to homestead settlement on March 1, 1909, setting out rules for registration and the drawing.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Harry H. Weddle as Inspector in Charge in Immigration Service Without Examination
summary: Allowed Harry H. Weddle of California to be appointed inspector in charge at San Diego in the Immigration Service without a civil-service examination.

title: Establishing Chase Lake Reservation in North Dakota as Reserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Established the Chase Lake Reservation, reserving public lands within Chase Lake's meander lines as a breeding ground for native birds, where taking birds, eggs or nests is prohibited.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Exceptions from Examination for Civilian Teachers in Military Academies
summary: Exempted civilian professors, instructors and teachers at the Military Academy at West Point and the Naval Academy at Annapolis from civil-service examination.

title: Some South Dakota Lands Within Belle Fourche Irrigation Project Further Reserved for Agricultural Experiments
summary: Reserved additional South Dakota lands within the Belle Fourche Irrigation Project for agricultural experiments.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Four People in Bureau of the Census Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Frank Dingman, C. W. G. Brett, Raymond Bartlett and Charles F. Young to be hired for tabulating statistics in the Bureau of the Census without civil-service rules.

title: Certain Land in California Reserved for Lighthouse Purposes
summary: Reserved a parcel of land in California for lighthouse purposes.

title: Creating Interdepartmental Statistical Committee to Promote Uniformity of Statistical Methods and Results
summary: Created an Interdepartmental Statistical Committee, with a member from each executive department and the Interstate Commerce Commission, to make government statistics uniform and cut duplicate work. Lawrence O. Murray was named chairman.

title: Setting Aside the Tumacacori National Monument, Arizona
summary: Set aside the Tumacacori Mission ruins, a Spanish mission in Santa Cruz County, and the ten acres beneath them as the Tumacacori National Monument.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Drs. Hopkins and Cunningham as Physicians on Isthmus of Panama Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Drs. Hopkins and Cunningham to be appointed, without civil-service rules, as physicians teaching microscopic work on tropical diseases at Ancon Hospital on the Isthmus of Panama.

title: Establishing Pine Island Reservation in Florida as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Created the Pine Island Reservation, protecting Bird Island, Middle Island and another small islet near the north end of Pine Island Sound as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Albert W. Pontius as Clerk in Department of State Without Examination
summary: Permitted Albert W. Pontius of Minnesota to be appointed a class-three clerk in the Department of State without examination.

title: Authorizing Transfer of Charles H. Cameron to Chinese Inspector in Immigration Service Without Examination
summary: Allowed customs officer Charles H. Cameron to transfer to Chinese inspector in the Immigration Service without examination.

title: Establishing Palma Sola Reservation in Florida as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Reserved a small island in Palma Sola Bay as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds, prohibiting the taking of birds, eggs or nests except under Agriculture Department rules.

title: Establishing Matlacha Pass Reservation in Florida as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Created the Matlacha Pass Reservation, setting aside four small islands in Matlacha Pass as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Authorizing Continued Employment of Three Clerks in Isthmian Canal Service Without Examination
summary: Let George Shaffer, Olof Ekedahl and Willoughby Culbertson stay on clerical duties in the Isthmian Canal Service without civil-service examination.

title: Reserving Lands in Circle, Alaska, for Use by Army Signal Corps as Wireless Telegraph Station
summary: Reserved a 0.71-acre tract at Circle for an Army Signal Corps wireless telegraph station serving Alaska's telegraph lines.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Melvin W. Sheppard as Night Inspector in Customs Service Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Melvin W. Sheppard to be appointed a night inspector in the customs service at the port of Philadelphia without meeting civil-service rules.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Exceptions from Examination for Certain Isthmian Canal Commission Employees
summary: Exempted one inspecting engineer and the inspectors in the Isthmian Canal Commission's purchasing department from civil-service examination.

title: Classifying Eight Employees of the Isthmian Canal Commission
summary: Brought eight people employed jointly by the Isthmian Canal Commission and the Panama Railroad Company into the Commission's classified force when the two offices' work was separated.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Retransfers to Positions Previously Held
summary: Broadened the civil-service retransfer rule so employees who had served continuously in the judicial as well as executive service could return to a former position.

title: Authorizing Classification of Certain Employees Hired Prior to Attorney General Ruling
summary: Allowed employees hired outside the civil-service rules before a February 12, 1908, Attorney General opinion to be classified with Civil Service Commission approval, with limits on their transfer.

title: Authorizing Appointment of William Norman as Assistant Inspector of Hulls in Steamboat Inspection Service Without Examination
summary: Allowed Captain William Norman to be appointed assistant inspector of hulls in the Steamboat-Inspection Service at New Orleans without examination.

title: Authorizing Appointment of John A. Flickinger as Watchman Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Permitted John A. Flickinger, three times certified from the watchman register, to be appointed a watchman in the classified service.

title: Amending Regulations Governing Employment of Unskilled Laborers Outside Washington, D.C. Regarding Demotions and Transfers
summary: Added a rule letting the Civil Service Commission approve demoting classified employees to unskilled laborer and transferring laborers between offices outside Washington, D.C.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Exceptions from Examination for Civilian Instructors in Revenue Cutter Service
summary: Exempted civilian instructors in the Revenue-Cutter Service from civil-service examination.

title: Amending Regulations Governing Employment of Unskilled Laborers in Washington, D.C. Regarding Demotions and Temporary Appointments
summary: Gave the labor board in Washington, D.C., authority to approve demotions to unskilled laborer and, in urgent cases, temporary laborer appointments longer than thirty days.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Frederick Koch as Disciplinarian at Indian School Upon Noncompetitive Examination
summary: Allowed Frederick Koch to be appointed disciplinarian at the Carlisle Indian School after a noncompetitive examination.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Conrad Henzman as Messenger in New York Military Headquarters Without Examination
summary: Let Conrad Henzman, a retired first sergeant with thirty years in the Army, be appointed messenger at military headquarters in New York City without examination.

title: Establishing Island Bay Reservation in Florida as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Created the Island Bay Reservation, setting aside unsurveyed mangrove and other islands in a Florida township as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Mary A. Eldridge as Clerk in War Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Permitted Mary A. Eldridge to be reinstated as a clerk in the office of the Auditor for the War Department, based on her earlier Patent Office service.

title: Reserving Lands on Montague Island, Prince William Sound, Alaska, for Use by Army Signal Corps in Operation of Telegraph Lines
summary: Reserved the northern part of Montague Point on Montague Island, where U.S. cables land, for the Army Signal Corps' military telegraph lines in Alaska.

title: Establishing Loch Katrine Reservation in Wyoming as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Created the Loch-Katrine Reservation, setting aside a reservoir site in Wyoming's Oregon Basin, plus a 50-foot strip around it, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Reserving Lands in Makanalua, Molokai Island, Hawaii, for Lighthouse Purposes
summary: Reserved land at Makanalua on the island of Molokai for lighthouse purposes.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Charles W. Edwards as Classified Laborer in Treasury Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Charles W. Edwards, an unclassified laborer in the office of the Register of the Treasury, to be made a classified laborer in the Treasury Department.

title: Thanksgiving Day, 1908
summary: Set apart Thursday, November 26, 1908, as a national day of thanksgiving.

title: Modifying Boundaries of Malate Barracks Reservation, Manila, Philippine Islands
summary: Redrew the boundaries of Parcel B of the Malate Barracks military reservation in Manila.

title: Certain Lands in Susitna and Tyonic, Alaska, Reserved for Educational Purposes
summary: Reserved certain lands at Susitna and Tyonic for educational purposes.

title: Amending Canal Zone Regulations Regarding Appeals, and Repealing Certain Sections of Code of Criminal Procedure
summary: Set new procedures for defendants appealing Canal Zone District Court judgments, including notice deadlines and bond limits, and repealed certain sections of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Exceptions from Examination for Transferred Employees in Isthmian Canal Commission
summary: Narrowed the Isthmian Canal Commission's civil-service exception so employees classified in 1904 into competitive positions are not covered by it on transfer.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Hilworth T. B. Jones as Translator in Office of Naval Intelligence Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed Hilworth T. B. Jones to be appointed a translator at $1,400 a year in the Office of Naval Intelligence without civil-service rules.

title: Defining the Duties of the United States Marine Corps
summary: Assigned the Marine Corps its duties: garrisoning navy yards and naval stations, defending overseas naval bases, garrisoning the Isthmian Canal Zone, and furnishing expeditionary forces abroad in peacetime.

title: Further Reserving Lands in Gila National Forest, New Mexico, to Protect Water Supply of Fort Bayard
summary: Withdrew two more tracts within the Gila National Forest for military use to protect Fort Bayard's water supply, keeping both reservations in force together.

title: Authorizing Retention of War Department Laborers in San Francisco
summary: Let three laborers hired at San Francisco after the 1906 earthquake and fire stay on with regular status, and allowed the Civil Service Commission to retain others hired the same way.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of George F. Cooke as Clerk in Post Office Without Regard to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed George F. Cooke to be reinstated to a post-office clerkship paying up to $1,000, regardless of the reinstatement time limit.

title: Civil War Veterans and Members of Women's Relief Corps and Sons of Veterans Excused from Duty Nov 25, 1908, for Unveiling of Statue of Philip Henry Sheridan
summary: Excused Civil War veterans and members of the Women's Relief Corps and Sons of Veterans in federal service from duty on November 25, 1908, for the unveiling of the Philip Henry Sheridan statue.

title: Dardanelle Land District, Ark., Abolished; Transferred to Little Rock Land District
summary: Abolished the Dardanelle land district in Arkansas and folded it into the Little Rock land district.

title: Restoring Certain Chehalis Indian Lands to Public Domain and Allotting Same to Ada McKay
summary: Returned a tract set aside for the Chehalis Indians to the public domain and directed that it be allotted to Ada McKay, a Skokomish Indian.

title: Setting Apart the Ocala National Forest, Florida
summary: Created the Ocala National Forest from partly timbered public lands in Florida, reserving them from settlement for the use and benefit of the people.

title: Setting Apart the Dakota National Forest, North Dakota
summary: Established the Dakota National Forest on partly timbered public lands in North Dakota, reserving them from settlement and entry.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Exceptions from Examination for Special Agents of General Land Office
summary: Cut the number of General Land Office special agents exempted from examination, who investigate fraudulent land entries, from five to three.

title: Forbidding Most Notaries Public in Government Service to Charge Fees for Notarial Acts
summary: Barred most federal employees who are notaries public from charging fees for notarial acts done for government business or during office hours, on pain of dismissal.

title: Reserving Lands on Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, for Observation Stations in Connection with Defensive Works
summary: Reserved land on Round Top (Ualakaa) and other Oahu sites, with rights-of-way, for observation stations tied to the island's defensive works.

title: Reserving Lands on North Side of Gulkana River, Alaska, for Use by Army Signal Corps in Operation of Telegraph Lines
summary: Set apart a tract on the north side of the Gulkana River, near the Gulkana Telegraph Station, for the Army Signal Corps' military telegraph lines.

title: Round Top and Sugar Loaf Military Reservation, Honolulu, Oahu, Hawaii, established.
Amendment of Executive Order No. 330-B of June 12, 1905, Establishing Limits of Punishment for Enlisted Men of the Army
summary: Revised the peacetime limits of punishment for Army enlisted men, capping confinement at hard labor for desertion at three years, with set conditions for modifying that limit.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Stephen C. Stuntz as Soil Bibliographer in Soils Bureau
summary: Allowed Stephen C. Stuntz to be appointed soil bibliographer in the Agriculture Department's Bureau of Soils without civil-service rules.

title: Setting Apart the Choctawhatchee National Forest, Florida
summary: Set apart the Choctawhatchee National Forest on partly timbered public lands in Florida.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules to Limit Exceptions from Examination for Certain Postmasters
summary: Narrowed a civil-service exception covering star-route employees and post offices without city delivery to fourteen northern and northeastern states, excluding fourth-class postmasters.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Fourth Class Postmasters Without Examination Until Civil Service Registers Available
summary: Let the Post-Office Department fill newly classified fourth-class postmaster vacancies without examination until the Civil Service Commission could certify eligibles.

title: Admission of Deaf-Mutes to Examinations for Civil Service
summary: Opened civil-service examinations to deaf-mutes for any classified position the Civil Service Commission judged they could perform.

title: Adding Certain Lands in Nonucan, Mindanao, Philippine Islands, to Camp Overton Military Reservation as Target Range
summary: Enlarged the Camp Overton military reservation at Nonucan, near Iligan on Mindanao, to add land for a target range.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Regarding Exceptions from Examination for Army Transport Service
summary: Rewrote the civil-service exception for the Army transport service, covering longshoremen, Philippine trade workers and most ship crews, and set conditions on later transfers or promotions.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Dell A. Baker as Deputy Collector in Office of Collector of Customs at Port of New York
summary: Permitted Dell A. Baker to be appointed deputy collector in the office of the collector of customs at the port of New York.

title: Reserving Land for Light-House Uses on Hana Bay, Maui Island, Hawaii
summary: Reserved for lighthouse purposes the U.S.-owned land on the island of Puukii at the entrance to Hana harbor, Maui.

title: Reserving Land for Light-House Uses at Lae o Kokole, Kauai Island, Hawaii
summary: Reserved a parcel at Lae o Kokole, in the Waimea district of Kauai, for lighthouse purposes, with a right-of-way to the government road.

title: Reserving Land for Light-House Uses at McGregor's Point, Maui Island, Hawaii
summary: Set aside land at McGregor's Point, in Maui's Lahaina district, for a lighthouse site and a keeper's dwelling site.

title: Reserving Land for Light-House Uses at Kahala Point, Kauai Island, Hawaii
summary: Reserved land at Kahala Point on Kauai for lighthouse purposes, along with a right-of-way to the Anahola wharf landing.

title: Reserving Land for Light-House Uses at Ka Lae, Hawaii Island, Hawaii
summary: Reserved about 10 acres at Ka Lae, in the Kau district of the island of Hawaii, for lighthouse purposes.

title: Setting Aside the Wheeler National Monument, Colorado
summary: Created the Wheeler National Monument to protect volcanic formations of unusual scientific interest within the Rio Grande and Cochetopa National Forests, making the monument the dominant reservation.

title: Colby Land District, Kansas, Abolished; Transferred to Topeka Land District
summary: Abolished the Colby land district in Kansas and transferred its business to the Topeka land district.

title: Prescribing Regulations for Physical Examinations for Marine Corps Officers
summary: Required Marine Corps officers to pass physical examinations and tests at least every two years, including a 90-mile, three-day riding test for field officers.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Georgia M. Sargent to Position in Classified Service
summary: Allowed Georgia M. Sargent, widow of Commissioner-General of Immigration Frank P. Sargent, to be appointed to a classified position without examination.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Wilhelm Lutz to Position in Customs Service
summary: Amended an earlier order so Wilhelm Lutz, assistant chief of police of Porto Rico, could be appointed to the U.S. Customs Service instead of the Immigration Bureau.

title: Authorizing Transfer of Walter R. Gallaher to Classified Clerical Position in United States
summary: Allowed Walter R. Gallaher, an $1,800 clerk in the Isthmian service, to transfer to a classified clerical position in the United States.

title: Authorizing Promotion of Herman W. Kuchmeister to Day Inspector
summary: Permitted Herman W. Kuchmeister, an assistant weigher in the Boston customs service, to be promoted to day inspector without further examination.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Clare Kiggins to Position in Classified Service Upon Passing Examination
summary: Allowed Clare Kiggins to be appointed to the departmental classified service after an appropriate noncompetitive examination.

title: Transfer of Clerks Serving in Cuba to Classified Service
summary: Let civilians employed temporarily in Cuba under the provisional government or the Army of Cuban Pacification transfer into the U.S. classified service within a year, if they passed the entrance exam and met service conditions.

title: Appointing H. A. Gudger as Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the Canal Zone
summary: Appointed H. A. Gudger Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the Canal Zone at $6,500 a year, effective January 4, 1909.

title: Appointing Wesley M. Owen as Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the Canal Zone
summary: Named Wesley M. Owen an Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the Canal Zone at $6,000 a year, effective January 4, 1909.

title: Authorizing Transfer of W. W. Adams to Position of Deputy Collector of Internal Revenue Upon Passing Examination
summary: Waived the six-month service requirement so W. W. Adams could transfer from the postal service to deputy collector of internal revenue once he passed an examination.

title: Authorizing Remission for Portion of Chinese Boxer Rebellion Indemnity
summary: Consented to limit China's Boxer indemnity bond payments to $13,655,492.69 plus 4 percent interest, remitting the rest of the U.S. share "as an act of friendship" under a May 1908 joint resolution of Congress.

title: Altering Lands Composing Reservation of Navajo Indians
summary: Returned to the public domain unallotted lands in New Mexico that 1907 and 1908 orders had added to the Navajo Reservation, except for 110 unapproved allotments described in the order.

title: Authorizing Admittance of C. M. Huntington to Examination Without Reference to Civil Service Rules
summary: Allowed C. M. Huntington to sit for a civil-service examination despite rule provisions that would have disqualified him.

title: Providing that Railroad Cars in Canal Zone Be Equipped with Safety Appliances
summary: Extended federal railroad safety-appliance laws to the Canal Zone, requiring automatic couplers, brakes, hand holds and other trainmen protections on carriers there, including the Panama Railroad.

title: Prescribing Regulations for Navy and Marine Corps Men Aboard Army Transports, and Army Men Aboard Naval Vessels
summary: Set rules for sailors and Marines riding Army transports, and soldiers aboard naval vessels: each follows the ship's regulations and shares police and guard duty when the commanding officer directs.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules Providing for Transfer After Two Years of Service in the Office of the President of the United States
summary: Amended civil-service Rule X so anyone who had served at least two years in the office of the President could transfer to a competitive classified position after tests of fitness.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Grace W. Nettleton to Clerkship in Treasury Department
summary: Permitted Grace W. Nettleton, ranked on Connecticut's clerk registers, to be appointed to a clerkship in the Treasury Department.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Fannie C. Chase as Skilled Laborer in Government Printing Office
summary: Let Fannie C. Chase return as a skilled laborer at the Government Printing Office without regard to the civil-service time limit on reinstatement.

title: Revoking Executive Order 632½ of May. 10, 1907, and Directing the Retransfer of the Vessel Zafiro, from the War Sec'y to the Navy Sec'y
summary: Revoked Executive Order 632½ of May 10, 1907, and directed that the vessel Zafiro be transferred back from the Secretary of War to the Secretary of the Navy.

title: Transferring Portion of Kaakaukukui Reef Naval Reservation in Hawaii to War Department
summary: Placed five and three-quarter acres of the Honolulu naval reservation on Kaakaukukui Reef under the Secretary of War to protect the harbor's submarine-mine defenses.

title: Land Office at Mitchell, S. Dak., Transferred to Gregory; Certain Described Lands of the Chamberlain Land District Transferred
summary: Moved the land office at Mitchell, South Dakota, to Gregory and transferred certain described lands out of the Chamberlain land district.

title: Creating the Council of the Fine Arts
summary: Created a Council of the Fine Arts, calling the attention of executive department heads to the President's correspondence with the American Institute of Architects on the subject.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Humboldt National Forest, Nevada
summary: Added timbered lands in Nevada to the Humboldt National Forest, formed the year before from the Ruby Mountains and Independence forests.

title: Setting Apart the Moapa National Forest, Nevada
summary: Enlarged the Moapa National Forest in Nevada, the 1908 merger of the Charleston and Vegas forests, by adding partly timbered public lands.

title: Re-establishing Fort Keogh Military Reservation in Montana
summary: Canceled a 1908 order turning Fort Keogh, Montana, over to the Interior Department, and placed the military reservation's lands back under the War Department for military use.

title: Authorizing Continuance of William H. Baldwin as Special Examiner in Corporations Bureau
summary: Allowed William H. Baldwin to stay on as a special examiner in the Bureau of Corporations for as long as the Department of Commerce and Labor needed him.

title: Reserving Certain Described Lands in Minnesota for Lighthouse Purposes
summary: Reserved certain described lands in Minnesota for lighthouse purposes.

title: Modifying Boundaries of Cleveland National Forest, California
summary: Redrew the Cleveland National Forest in Southern California, adding partly timbered lands and cutting out others, which returned to the public domain.

title: Enlarging Pelican Island Reservation, Florida
summary: Enlarged Florida's Pelican Island Reservation to take in unreserved mangrove and other islands nearby, keeping the ban on hunting birds or taking their eggs there.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Edwin W. Hutcheson in Classified Service Upon Passing Examination
summary: Permitted Edwin W. Hutcheson to be reinstated in the classified service in any department, once he passed an appropriate examination.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Pecos National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Expanded the Pecos National Forest in the Territory of New Mexico with additional partly timbered public lands.

title: Authorizing Appointment of Edward C. Baker as Clerk of Class 3 in State Department
summary: Allowed Edward C. Baker, a former vice-consul in China, to be appointed a class 3 clerk in the State Department for his special knowledge of Far East affairs.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Daniel F. Dolan as Post-Office Inspector with Suspension of Sixty Days
summary: Reinstated Daniel F. Dolan as a post-office inspector, with a sixty-day suspension starting on the date of his return.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Prescott National Forest, Arizona
summary: Grew the Prescott National Forest in Arizona Territory, recently merged with the Verde forest, by adding partly timbered lands.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules to Except National Bank Examiners and Receivers from Examination
summary: Excepted national-bank examiners and receivers under the Comptroller of the Currency from civil-service examination.

title: Establishing Hawaiian Islands Reservation as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Set aside a chain of islets and reefs at the far western end of the Hawaiian Archipelago, from Cure Island to Necker Island, as the Hawaiian Islands Reservation for native birds.

title: Reserving Certain Described Lands in Minnesota for Lighthouse Purposes
summary: Reserved certain described lands in Minnesota for lighthouse purposes.

title: Reserving Certain Described Lands on Michigan Island, Wisconsin, for Lighthouse Purposes
summary: Set aside certain described lands on Michigan Island, Wisconsin, for lighthouse purposes.

title: Time Limit for Completion of Work of Spanish Treaty Claims Commission Extended to Sept. 2, 1909
summary: Extended the deadline for the Spanish Treaty Claims Commission to finish its work to September 2, 1909.

title: Lands Near Rampart, Alaska, Reserved for Agriculture Dept. Experiment Station
summary: Reserved lands near Rampart, Alaska, for a Department of Agriculture experiment station.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Tonto National Forest, Arizona
summary: Added partly timbered lands and undergrowth in Arizona Territory to the Tonto National Forest.

title: Setting Apart the Marquette National Forest, Michigan
summary: Created the Marquette National Forest from partly timbered public lands in Michigan, reserving them from settlement or entry.

title: Setting Apart the Nevada National Forest, Nevada
summary: Established the Nevada National Forest, setting apart partly timbered public lands in the state for the use and benefit of the people.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Dixie National Forest, Utah and Arizona
summary: Enlarged the Dixie National Forest with partly timbered lands in Utah.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of Charles B. Brewer as Ship Drafts in the Bureau of Construction and Repairs, Navy Department
summary: Allowed Charles B. Brewer to return as a ship draftsman in the Navy's Bureau of Construction and Repair regardless of how long he had been out of service.

title: Authorizing Promotion of James J. Smith to Day Inspector in the Customs Service at the Port of New York
summary: Permitted James J. Smith's promotion from night inspector to day inspector in the Customs Service at the port of New York.

title: Setting Apart the Michigan National Forest, Michigan
summary: Set apart partly timbered public lands in Michigan as the Michigan National Forest, closed to settlement or entry.

title: Centennial Anniversary of the Birth of Abraham Lincoln
summary: Declared February 12, 1909, the 100th anniversary of Abraham Lincoln's birth, a special legal holiday in the District of Columbia and the territories, as a joint resolution of Congress directed.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Klamath National Forest, California
summary: Extended the Klamath National Forest in California with additional partly timbered lands.

title: Setting Apart the Superior National Forest, Minnesota
summary: Created the Superior National Forest in Minnesota, reserving partly timbered public lands from settlement or entry for the use and benefit of the people.

title: Enlarging Naval Reservation on Subic Bay, Olongapo, Philippine Islands
summary: Reserved lands north of the Olongapo naval reservation on Subic Bay in the Philippines for naval purposes, extending its boundaries under the Secretary of the Navy.

title: Modifying Boundaries of Gila National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Changed the Gila National Forest's boundaries in New Mexico Territory, adding partly timbered lands and releasing others back to the public domain.

title: Modifying Boundaries of Black Hills National Forest, South Dakota and Wyoming
summary: Revised the Black Hills National Forest, whose Wyoming portion had gone to the Sundance forest in 1908, by adding partly timbered lands in South Dakota.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Sioux National Forest, Montana and South Dakota
summary: Enlarged the Sioux National Forest, a 1908 merger of five Montana and South Dakota forests, with more partly timbered lands in South Dakota.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Tongass National Forest, Alaska
summary: Expanded the Tongass National Forest in southeast Alaska, redrawing its bounds from the Skagway River along the Canadian boundary to Cape Muzon.

title: Creating 6th Internal Revenue District in California by Removing Counties from 1st District
summary: Created a sixth internal revenue district in California by taking counties out of the first district.

title: Authorizing Reinstatement of R. Barnard Talcott as Assistant Engineer in Office of Supervising Architect of the Treasury
summary: Allowed R. Barnard Talcott to be reinstated as assistant chief mechanical and electrical engineer in the Supervising Architect's office without meeting civil-service rules.

title: Authorizing Promotion of John Hunter, Peter J. Kaster, and Joseph Stangle to Assistant Weigher in the Customs Service at the Port of New York
summary: Waived promotion rules so John Hunter, Peter J. Kaster and Joseph Stangle could move from laborer to assistant weigher in the Customs Service at the port of New York.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Toiyabe National Forest, Nevada
summary: Added partly timbered Nevada lands to the Toiyabe National Forest, consolidated in 1908 with the Monitor and Toquima forests.

title: Reciprocity with Spain
summary: Extended the 1906 commercial agreement with Spain to sparkling wines, setting reduced U.S. duties on Spanish sparkling wine in exchange for Spanish concessions on American goods.

title: Consolidating the Datil and Magdalena National Forests, New Mexico
summary: Combined the Datil and Magdalena National Forests, plus unreserved timbered lands in New Mexico Territory, into a single forest named the Datil National Forest.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Chugach National Forest, Alaska
summary: Enlarged Alaska's Chugach National Forest, taking in Afognak Island and the former Afognak Forest and Fish Culture Reserve plus public lands around the Copper River and Kenai Mountains.

title: Lands on Copper and Klutina Rivers, Alaska, Reserved for Joint Educational and Agricultural Experiment Purposes
summary: Reserved lands along the Copper and Klutina Rivers in Alaska for joint educational and agricultural experiment purposes.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Modoc National Forest, California
summary: Added partly timbered California lands to the Modoc National Forest, merged in 1908 with the Warner Mountains forest.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Ozark National Forest, Arkansas
summary: Enlarged the Ozark National Forest in Arkansas with additional partly timbered lands.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of California National Forest, California
summary: Expanded the California National Forest, formed in 1908 from parts of the Stony Creek and Trinity forests, with more partly timbered lands.

title: Authorizing Employment of F. N. Clark in Interstate Commerce Commission
summary: Allowed F. N. Clark to be hired as a clerk at the Interstate Commerce Commission without regard to civil-service rules.

title: Establishing Seventeen Reservations as Preserves and Breeding Grounds for Native Birds
summary: Turned seventeen Reclamation Service reservoir sites in ten western states and territories, from Salt River, Arizona, to Pathfinder, Wyoming, into preserves and breeding grounds for native birds.

title: Making Ten Employees of the Spanish Treaty Claims Commission Eligible for Transfer to Competitive Service
summary: Made ten Spanish Treaty Claims Commission employees commended by its president eligible for transfer to the competitive service after noncompetitive examination.

title: Convening a Special Session of the United States Senate
summary: Called the U.S. Senate into special session at noon on March 4, 1909, to receive communications from the Executive.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Arkansas National Forest, Arkansas
summary: Added more partly timbered lands in Arkansas to the Arkansas National Forest.

title: Making Five Employees of the Office of the Assistant Attorney-General Eligible for Transfer to Competitive Service
summary: Made five employees of the Assistant Attorney-General's office defending Spanish Treaty Claims suits eligible for transfer to the competitive service after noncompetitive examination.

title: Authorizing Transfer of Roger H. Adams to Competitive Position in United States
summary: Let Roger H. Adams, a clerk in the Isthmian service, transfer to a competitive position in the United States, subject to examination.

title: Reserving Lands in Nome, Alaska, for Use by Army Signal Corps as Wireless Telegraph Station
summary: Reserved three town blocks in Nome, Alaska, for an Army Signal Corps wireless telegraph station tied to the territory's telegraph lines.

title: Establishing Bering Sea Reservation as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Reserved Saint Matthew Island, Hall Island and Pinnacle Islet in the Bering Sea as the Bering Sea Reservation, a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Establishing Fire Island Reservation, Cook Inlet, Alaska, as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Alaska Moose
summary: Set aside Fire Island, near the head of Cook Inlet, Alaska, as a preserve and breeding ground for the Alaska moose.

title: Establishing Tuxedni Reservation, Alaska, as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Protected Chisick Island and Egg Island at the entrance to Tuxedni Harbor, Cook Inlet, as the Tuxedni Reservation for native birds, outlawing hunting or egg-taking there.

title: Establishing Saint Lazaria Reservation, Alaska, as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Made Saint Lazaria Island, at the entrance to Sitka Sound, a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Establishing Yukon Delta Reservation, Alaska, as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Reserved the treeless tundra of the Yukon River delta in Alaska as the Yukon Delta Reservation, a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Establishment of a Bird Reservation on the Island of Culebra, Porto Rico
summary: Set apart the islands of the Culebra group in Puerto Rico, except Culebra Island itself, as a native-bird preserve, subject to existing naval and lighthouse uses.

title: Establishing Farallon Reservation, California, as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Reserved the Middle and North Farallon islands and nearby rocks off California as the Farallon Reservation, a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

title: Establishing Pribilof Reservation, Alaska, as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Protected Walrus and Otter islands in Alaska's Pribilof group as a native-bird preserve, subject to existing law on fur-bearing animals.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Mono National Forest, California and Nevada
summary: Added partly timbered lands in California and Nevada to the Mono National Forest.

title: Enlarging the Sitgreaves National Forest, Arizona
summary: Brought timbered parts of the White Mountain Apache Indian Reservation into Arizona's Sitgreaves National Forest, with provisos covering allotments to Indians and grazing use.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Lincoln National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Enlarged the Lincoln National Forest, merged in 1908 with the Gallinas forest, by adding partly timbered lands in New Mexico Territory.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Shasta National Forest, California
summary: Expanded the Shasta National Forest with partly timbered California lands, including part of the area formerly in the Lassen National Forest.

title: Enlarging the Alamo National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Added timbered parts of the Mescalero Apache Indian Reservation to the Alamo National Forest in New Mexico Territory, with provisos for continued use for the Indians.

title: Enlarging the Carson National Forest, New Mexico
summary: Enlarged the Carson National Forest with unreserved lands and part of the Jicarilla Apache Indian Reservation, with provisos for continued use for the Indians.

title: Enlarging the Zuni National Forest, Arizona and New Mexico
summary: Took public lands, including parts of the Zuni and Navajo Indian Reservations, into the Zuni National Forest, keeping for 25 years the government's right to allot those lands to individual Indians.

title: Enlarging the Trinity National Forest, California
summary: Added timbered parts of the Hoopa Valley Indian Reservation in California to the Trinity National Forest, with provisos for continued use for the Indians.

title: Enlarging the Apache National Forest, Arizona
summary: Enlarged Arizona's Apache National Forest with timbered lands from the White Mountain Apache Indian Reservation, with provisos for continued use for the Indians.

title: Transferring Part of Lassen National Forest, California, to Shasta National Forest, and Including Other Lands
summary: Redrew the Lassen National Forest, shifting part of it to the Shasta National Forest and adding other partly timbered California lands.

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Plumas National Forest, California
summary: Added partly timbered lands in California to the Plumas National Forest.

title: Setting Aside Mount Olympus National Monument, Washington
summary: Created Mount Olympus National Monument in Washington's Olympic Mountains to protect its glaciers and the summer range and breeding grounds of the Olympic elk, a species "rapidly decreasing in numbers."

title: Enlarging Boundaries of Tahoe National Forest, California and Nevada
summary: Extended the Tahoe National Forest with partly timbered lands in California and Nevada.

title: Enlarging the Sequoia National Forest, California
summary: Brought timbered parts of the Tule River Indian Reservation into California's Sequoia National Forest, with provisos for continued use for the Indians.

title: Authorizing Appointment of James Mullenbach to Inspector in Immigration Service Without Examination
summary: Allowed James Mullenbach to be appointed, without examination, as the Immigration Service inspector in charge of information and distribution work in Chicago, given his particular qualifications.

title: Amending Civil Service Rules to Make United States Marshal Office Deputies Competitive
summary: Narrowed the civil-service exception in U.S. marshals' offices to field deputies and those whose chief duty is serving process, bringing other deputies into the competitive service.

title: Authorizing Appointment of John M. Longan to Clerical Position in Classified Service
summary: Permitted John M. Longan of Massachusetts to be appointed to a clerical position in the classified service without meeting civil-service requirements.

title: Federal Employees in District of Columbia Excused From Work on Inauguration Day
summary: Excused federal employees in the District of Columbia from work on Inauguration Day.

title: Establishing Bogoslof Reservation, Alaska, as Preserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
summary: Made the volcanic Bogoslof islands in Alaska's Aleutian chain a preserve and breeding ground for native birds, named the Bogoslof Reservation.

title: Making Six Employees of the Department of Justice Eligible for Transfer to Competitive Service
summary: Made six Justice Department employees, paid from the antitrust enforcement and Five Civilized Tribes appropriations, eligible for transfer to the competitive service after noncompetitive examination.

title: Blank Number in the Official File of Numbered Orders
summary: A blank number in the official file of numbered executive orders.
